title.zh: 卷三十四 本紀第三十四 孝宗二
title.raw: 卷三十四 本紀第三十四 孝宗二 Volume 34 Annals 34: Xiaozong 2

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲辰，詔廷尉大理官毋以獄情白宰執，探刺旨意爲輕重。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the day jiachen of the third year, an edict ordered officials of the Court of Judicial Review and the Office of Review not to report the facts of cases to the chief ministers or probe their intentions in order to grade punishments as light or heavy.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year, on the first month’s jiachen day, an edict forbade Court of Judicial Review and Office of Review officials from briefing the chief ministers on case details or sounding out their wishes to fix sentences as lenient or severe.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，置三省戶房國用司。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the National Finance Office of the Three Departments Household Section was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the Three Departments established a National Finance Office in their Household Section.

sentences.zh: 初，以國用匱乏，罷江州屯駐軍馬，至是復留之。

translations.literal: Earlier, because state finances were depleted, the garrison horses stationed at Jiangzhou had been withdrawn; at this time they were retained again.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, depleted state revenues had led to the withdrawal of the garrison cavalry at Jiangzhou; now they were stationed there again.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，罷銅錢過江之禁。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the prohibition on transporting copper cash across the Yangzi was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the ban on moving copper coin south of the Yangzi was lifted.

sentences.zh: 裁定利州西路諸軍額。

translations.literal: Fixed the establishment quotas for the various armies of Lizhou West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Establishment quotas were set for the armies of Lizhou West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，詔國用司月上宮禁及百司官吏、三衙將士請給之數。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renshen, an edict ordered the National Finance Office to report monthly to the palace the sums for stipends to officials of the hundred offices, the Three Yamen officers and soldiers, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renshen day, an edict required the National Finance Office each month to report palace disbursements and the pay drawn by officials of all ministries, the Three Yamen, and the guard armies.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，出龍大淵爲江東總管，曾覿爲淮西總管。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Long Dayuan was sent out as supreme commander of Jiangdong, and Zeng Di as supreme commander of Huaixi.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Long Dayuan was posted out as Jiangdong supreme commander and Zeng Di as Huaixi supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大淵改浙東，覿改福建。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Dayuan was changed to Zhedong, and Di to Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Dayuan’s command was shifted to Zhedong and Di’s to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 乙亥。

translations.literal: On the day yihai.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day.

sentences.zh: 罷成都、潼川路轉運司輪年銓試，以其事付制置司。

translations.literal: The rotating annual examination for transport commissioners of the Chengdu and Tongchuan circuits was abolished, and the matter was entrusted to the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Rotating annual civil-service examinations for Chengdu and Tongchuan transport commissioners were ended, and the Pacification Commission took over the duty.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以端明殿學士虞允文知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Yu Yunwen, academician of the Duanming Hall, was appointed to know the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Duanming Hall academician Yu Yunwen was made acting head of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸未，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 甲申，爲知陳州陳亨祖立廟於光州，賜名湣忠。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, a temple was erected at Guangzhou for Chen Hengzu, former prefect of Chenzhou, and the name Minzhong was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, a shrine was raised at Guangzhou to Chen Hengzu, late prefect of Chenzhou, and given the name Minzhong.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以《武經龜鑒》、《孫子》賜鎮江都統戚方、建康都統劉源。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, The Military Mirror of the Tortoise and the Sunzi were bestowed on Qi Fang, commander at Zhenjiang, and Liu Yuan, commander at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the emperor granted the Military Mirror of the Tortoise and the Art of War to Zhenjiang commander-in-chief Qi Fang and Jiankang commander-in-chief Liu Yuan.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，措置淮東山水砦。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, mountain-and-water stockades in Huaidong were arranged.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, mountain and river stockades in Huaidong were organized.

sentences.zh: 丙申，從太上皇、太上皇后幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the emperor accompanied the Retired Emperor and the Retired Empress to Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, he accompanied the retired emperor and retired empress to Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，直秘閣、前廣東提刑石敦義犯髒，刺面配柳州，籍其家。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Shi Dunyi, acting secretariat gentleman and former Guangdong judicial intendant, committed bribery; his face was tattooed and he was banished to Liuzhou, and his household registers were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Acting Secretariat Gentleman and former Guangdong judicial intendant Shi Dunyi was convicted of graft, tattooed, and exiled to Liuzhou; his family property was forfeited.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，從太上皇、太上皇后幸聚景園。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiachen, the emperor accompanied the Retired Emperor and the Retired Empress to Jujing Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiachen day, he again accompanied the retired emperor and retired empress to Jujing Garden.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詣德壽宮，恭請裁定醫官員額。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, he went to Deshou Palace and respectfully requested a ruling on the quotas for medical officers.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, he visited Deshou Palace and asked the retired emperor to fix the establishment for medical officers.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔四川宣撫司創招千人，置司所在屯駐。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, an edict ordered the Sichuan Pacification Commission to recruit a thousand men anew and station them at the commission seat.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, an edict told the Sichuan Pacification Commission to raise another thousand troops and garrison them at its headquarters.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，伯母秀王夫人張氏薨。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the wife of his father’s younger brother, the Prince of Xiu, Lady Zhang, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Lady Zhang, consort of his uncle the Prince of Xiu, died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，蠲諸路州軍逋負。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day xinwei, arrears owed to prefectures and armies on all circuits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinwei day, overdue payments owed by circuits, prefectures, and armies were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，爲秀王王夫人成服于後苑，百官進名奉慰。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, mourning garments were completed for the Prince of Xiu’s lady in the rear garden, and the hundred officials advanced their names to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, he finished mourning for the Prince of Xiu’s consort in the rear garden, and all officials submitted condolence messages.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，合利州東、西路爲一。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Lizhou East and West circuits were merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Lizhou East and West circuits were united into a single circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以吳璘知興元府、充利州路安撫使、四川宣撫使。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Wu Lin was appointed prefect of Xingyuan, pacification commissioner of Lizhou Circuit, and pacification commissioner of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Wu Lin was made prefect of Xingyuan, Lizhou pacification commissioner, and Sichuan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，葉顒等上《三祖下仙源積慶圖》及《太宗真宗玉牒》、《哲宗寶訓》。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guimao, Ye Meng and others presented the Chart of Accumulated Blessings in the Immortal Source below the Three Ancestors, together with the jade registers of Taizong and Zhenzong and the precious instructions of Zhezong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guimao day, Ye Meng and others submitted the Chart of Accumulated Blessings from the Three Ancestors’ Immortal Lineage, along with the jade registers of Taizong and Zhenzong and Zhezong’s treasured admonitions.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，吳璘薨。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Wu Lin died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Wu Lin died.

sentences.zh: 庚申。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day.

sentences.zh: 命四川制置使汪應辰主管宣撫司事，移司利州。

translations.literal: The Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Wang Yingchen was ordered to take charge of pacification commission affairs and moved the office to Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Wang Yingchen was assigned to direct the pacification headquarters, which was moved to Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 修揚州城。

translations.literal: The walls of Yangzhou were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhou’s walls were repaired.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大減三衙官屬。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the staff of the Three Yamen was greatly reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, personnel in the Three Yamen was sharply cut.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，命汪應辰權節制利州路屯駐御前軍馬。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jisi, Wang Yingchen was ordered to exercise temporary control over the imperial front armies garrisoned in Lizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jisi day, Wang Yingchen was authorized to command the imperial front armies stationed in Lizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛未，復分利州東、西路爲二。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Lizhou East and West circuits were again divided into two.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Lizhou was split once more into East and West circuits.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以虞允文爲資政殿大學士、四川宣撫使。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Yu Yunwen was made Grand Master of the Palace of Treasury and Sichuan Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Yu Yunwen was appointed Grand Master of the Palace of Treasury and Sichuan Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，金遣使來取被俘人。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the Jin sent envoys to take back captured persons.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Jin envoys arrived to reclaim captives.

sentences.zh: 詔實俘在民間者還之，軍中人及叛亡者不預。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that persons actually held captive among the populace be returned; persons in the armies and defectors and fugitives were not included.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that real civilian captives be returned, but troops, deserters, and fugitives were excluded.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，復以虞允文爲知樞密院事，充宣撫使，帝親書九事戒之。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Yu Yunwen was again made to know the Bureau of Military Affairs and commissioned pacification commissioner; the emperor personally wrote nine admonitions to warn him.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Yu Yunwen was again made head of Military Affairs while retaining the pacification post; the emperor wrote nine injunctions by his own hand.

sentences.zh: 罷淮西、江東總領所營田，募人耕佃，壯丁各還本屯，癃老存留，減半請給。

translations.literal: The military estate farms of the Huai West and Jiangdong chief steward offices were abolished; tenants were recruited to farm and rent the land; able-bodied men each returned to their original camps, while the infirm and aged who remained had their stipends halved.
translations.idiomatic: Huai West and Jiangdong commandery estate farms were shut down and opened to tenant cultivation; fit men went back to their home camps, while sick and elderly retainers had their pay cut in half.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔鎮江都統制戚方、武鋒軍都統制陳敏各上清河口戰守之策。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, an edict ordered Zhenjiang commander-in-chief Qi Fang and Wufeng Army commander Chen Min each to submit plans for attack and defense at Qinghekou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, an edict required Zhenjiang commander Qi Fang and Wufeng commander Chen Min to report strategies for Qinghekou.

sentences.zh: 追封吳璘爲信王。

translations.literal: Posthumous enfeoffment of Wu Lin as Prince of Xin was pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Xin.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔後省參考理檢院典故。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict ordered the Rear Secretariat to consult precedents of the Review Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, an edict told the Rear Secretariat to study Review Office precedent.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，皇后夏氏崩。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Empress Xia died.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Empress Xia died.

sentences.zh: 振泉州水災。

translations.literal: Relief was extended for the flood disaster in Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhou’s flood victims were given relief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，立薦舉改官額。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day jihai, quotas were established for promotion by recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jihai day, quotas were set for recommendation-based promotions.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以皇太子疾，減雜犯死罪囚，釋流以下。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, because the crown prince was ill, death sentences for miscellaneous crimes were reduced, and those below exile were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, with the crown prince gravely ill, miscellaneous capital crimes were commuted and prisoners below the exile grade were freed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，皇太子薨，諡曰莊文。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the crown prince died; his posthumous title was Zhuangwen.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the crown prince died and was given the posthumous name Zhuangwen.

sentences.zh: 己酉，東宮醫官杜揖除名、昭州編管，尋改瓊州。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Eastern Palace physician Du Yi was stripped of his name and banished to Zhaozhou for registration; soon he was changed to Qiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Eastern Palace physician Du Yi was disgraced and exiled to Zhaozhou, then reassigned to Qiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛未，詔諸軍復置副都統制，文字與都統制連書，軍馬調發從都統制，違者奏劾。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day xinwei, an edict ordered all armies again to establish vice commanders-in-chief; their documents were to be signed jointly with the commander-in-chief, and troop movements followed the commander-in-chief, with violations subject to impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the xinwei day, an edict restored deputy commanders in every army; orders were co-signed with the commander, who alone directed deployments, on pain of impeachment.

sentences.zh: 戚方罷。

translations.literal: Qi Fang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Fang was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，權欑安恭皇后于臨安修吉寺。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Empress Gong was temporarily enshrined at Xiuji Temple in Lin’an.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Empress Gong was provisionally lodged at Xiuji Temple in Lin’an.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，戚方落節鉞、信州居住。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Qi Fang was stripped of his seals of command and ordered to reside in Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Qi Fang lost his command seals and was sent to live in Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，內侍陳瑜、李宗回坐交結戚方受賂，瑜除名、決杖、黥面配循州，宗回除名、筠州編管，方責授果州團練副使、潭州安置，籍所盜庫金以犒軍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingyou, the eunuchs Chen Yu and Li Zonghui were convicted of associating with Qi Fang and taking bribes; Yu was stripped of his name, beaten with the rod, tattooed, and banished to Xunzhou; Zonghui was stripped of his name and registered in Yunzhou; Fang was demoted to deputy military training commissioner of Guozhou and settled in Tanzhou, and the stolen treasury gold in his possession was registered and used to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the dingyou day, eunuchs Chen Yu and Li Zonghui were punished for colluding with Qi Fang and taking bribes: Yu was disgraced, flogged, tattooed, and sent to Xunzhou; Zonghui was disgraced and exiled to Yunzhou; Fang was demoted to Guozhou deputy commissioner and confined at Tanzhou, and his stolen treasury gold was confiscated for troop rewards.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以久雨，命臨安府決系囚。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, because of prolonged rain, Lin’an Prefecture was ordered to decide cases of prisoners in custody.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, prolonged rains led to an order for Lin’an to dispose of detained prisoners’ cases.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，葉顒等請罷，不許。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Ye Meng and others requested dismissal; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Ye Meng and others asked to resign, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 蠲光、濠、廬三州、壽春府賦一年。

translations.literal: One year’s levies of Guang, Hao, and Lu prefectures and Shouchun Prefecture were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes for one year were forgiven in Guang, Hao, and Lu prefectures and Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遣官分決滯獄。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, officials were dispatched to decide cases long pending in the prisons.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, commissioners were sent to clear backlog cases in the jails.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以知建康府史正志兼沿江水軍制置使，自鹽官至鄂州沿江南北及沿海十五州水軍悉隸之。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Shi Zhengzhi, prefect of Jiankang, was also made pacification commissioner of the along-river naval forces; from the salt office north to Ezhou, all naval forces along the Yangzi and north and south, and along the coast in fifteen prefectures, were placed under his command.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Jiankang prefect Shi Zhengzhi was also named along-river naval pacification commissioner, with every fleet from the salt bureau north to Ezhou and fifteen coastal prefectures placed under him.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔給、舍討論考課舊法。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, an edict ordered drafting and editing officials to discuss the old law on merit evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, an edict called on drafting and editing officials to review the former performance-appraisal code.

sentences.zh: 四川旱，賜制置司度牒四百，備振濟。

translations.literal: Sichuan suffered drought; four hundred quota certificates were granted to the Pacification Commission for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Drought struck Sichuan, and four hundred relief certificates were issued to the Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day wuzi, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wuzi day, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未朔，占城入貢。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the new moon day yimao, Champa sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yimao new moon, Champa presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遣唐瑑等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Tang Qian and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Tang Qian and others were dispatched to the Jin court for New Year felicitations.

sentences.zh: 戊戌。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day.

sentences.zh: 修真州城。

translations.literal: The walls of Zhenzhou were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenzhou’s walls were repaired.

sentences.zh: 以嗣濮王士輵爲開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: The heir to the Prince of Pu, Shi Yu, was made Grand Preceptor with the honorific title Kaifu Yitong Sansi.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yu, heir to the Prince of Pu, was appointed Grand Preceptor with the ceremonial rank of Kaifu Yitong Sansi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，定內外薦舉改官人歲額。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, annual quotas were fixed for persons promoted by internal and external recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, yearly quotas were set for recommendation-based promotions inside and outside the court.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔歸正借補官資人充樞密院效士，於指定州軍以官庫酒息贍之者，毋罷其給。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, an edict ordered that persons of Guizheng status who had borrowed office and salary grants and served as effectives of the Bureau of Military Affairs, supported in designated prefectures and armies from wine-tax interest in the state treasuries, should not have that support cut off.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, an edict protected Guizheng clients who had borrowed office and pay to serve as Military Affairs effectives funded by wine-tax revenues in assigned prefectures—their stipends were not to be stopped.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，金遣蒲察莎魯窩等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the Jin sent Pucha Shaluwo and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, the Jin dispatched Pucha Shaluwo and others to felicitate the Joint Celebration Festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，合祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingyin, Heaven and Earth were worshiped together at the Round Mound, and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the bingyin day, a combined sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was held at the Round Mound and a general amnesty declared.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，雷。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, thunder sounded.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔戒飭武臣及百官。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, an edict admonished military officials and all officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, an edict warned military and civil officials to mend their conduct.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以郊祀雷，葉顒、魏杞並罷，命陳俊卿爲參知政事，翰林學士劉珙同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, because of thunder at the suburban sacrifice, Ye Meng and Wei Qi were both dismissed; Chen Junqing was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Hanlin academician Liu Gong Associate Director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, thunder during the suburban rites brought the dismissal of Ye Meng and Wei Qi; Chen Junqing became Vice Director of the Secretariat and Hanlin academician Liu Gong Associate Director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，蔣芾、陳俊卿請罷，不許。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Jiang Fu and Chen Junqing requested dismissal; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Jiang Fu and Chen Junqing asked to resign, but were refused.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以雷發非時，詔臺諫、侍從、兩省官指陳闕失。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, because thunder had come out of season, an edict ordered remonstrance officials, attendants, and members of the two palace secretariats to point out governmental failings.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, untimely thunder prompted an edict inviting censors, attendants, and secretariat officials to lay out governmental faults.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔侍從、兩省、臺諫、卿監、郎官舉堪郎官、寺監丞、監司、郡守者。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, an edict ordered attendants, the two secretariats, censors, ministers and vice ministers, and bureau directors and section chiefs to recommend persons fit for section chief, directorate assistant, circuit intendant, and prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, an edict called on courtiers from attendants through section chiefs to nominate candidates for section chief, directorate aide, circuit commissioner, and prefect.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，罷川路馬船。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, horse transports on the Sichuan routes were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, Sichuan route horse convoys were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，增修六合城。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingshen, the walls of Liuhe were expanded and repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingshen day, Liuhe’s walls were enlarged and repaired.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遣王瀹賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Wang Yuan was sent to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Wang Yuan was sent to offer birthday felicitations to the Jin emperor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，置豐儲倉。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Abundant Stores Granary was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, the Abundant Stores Granary was founded.

sentences.zh: 增印會子。

translations.literal: The printing of huizi notes was increased.
translations.idiomatic: More huizi paper money was put into circulation.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以吳益爲太傅。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Wu Yi was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Wu Yi was appointed Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 庚申，金遣徒單忠衛等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the Jin sent Tushan Zhongwei and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the Jin sent Tushan Zhongwei and others to felicitate the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩浙水，四川旱，江東西、湖南北路蝗，振之。

translations.literal: This year, the two Zhe circuits suffered flood; Sichuan suffered drought; Jiangdong, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Hubei north suffered locusts; relief was extended.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods hit the two Zhe circuits, drought afflicted Sichuan, and locusts ravaged Jiangdong, Jiangxi, and north Hunan and Hubei; relief was provided in each case.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午朔，罷福建路賣鈔鹽，蠲轉運司歲發鈔鹽錢十五萬緡。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the new moon day jiawu, the sale of salt certificates in the Fujian circuit was abolished, and the transport commission’s annual dispatch of fifteen hundred thousand strings in salt-certificate money was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiawu new moon, Fujian’s sale of salt coupons was ended and the transport office’s annual fifteen-million-string salt levy was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 詔四川宣撫使虞允文集四路漕臣會計財賦所入，對立兵額。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Yu Yunwen to assemble the transport officials of the four circuits and reckon revenues entering the treasury, setting troop quotas against them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Yu Yunwen to convene the four circuits’ transport commissioners, tally fiscal intake, and match army quotas to it.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命湖北安撫司給田募辰、沅、靖三州刀弩手。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the Hubei Pacification Commission was ordered to grant land and recruit crossbowmen of the knife-and-crossbow corps in Chen, Yuan, and Jing prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the Hubei Pacification Commission was told to allot land and recruit knife-and-crossbow troops from Chen, Yuan, and Jing.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，置和州鑄錢鹽。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, a Hezhou coin- and salt-casting office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, a Hezhou mint and salt works was set up.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以蔣芾爲尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使兼制國用使，觀文殿大學士史浩爲四川制置使，浩辭不行。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Jiang Fu was made Minister of the Right, Grand Councilor, and concurrently Director of Military Affairs and Commissioner for State Finances; Grand Master of the Palace for Glorious Culture Shi Hao was made Sichuan Pacification Commissioner, but Hao declined and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Jiang Fu became Minister of the Right, Grand Councilor, Military Affairs director, and state-finance commissioner; Glorious Culture palace academician Shi Hao was named Sichuan pacification commissioner but declined to take up the post.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔蔣芾常朝，贊拜不名。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, an edict ordered Jiang Fu to attend regular court; in ceremonial obeisance his name was not called.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, an edict required Jiang Fu at ordinary audiences and excused him from having his name announced in the bowing ritual.

sentences.zh: 芾辭，許之。

translations.literal: Fu declined; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Fu asked to be excused, and permission was given.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賜王炎出身，簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Wang Yan was granted status as a degree holder and appointed to sign the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Wang Yan was given examination standing and named to sign Military Affairs documents.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，五星皆見。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, all five planets were visible.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, all five planets appeared together.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，雪，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, snow fell, and hail followed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, snow fell and hail came afterward.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，以敷文閣待制晁公武爲四川安撫制置使。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengwu, Chao Gongwu, awaiting appointment in the Fuweng Hall, was made Sichuan Pacification and Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengwu day, Fuweng Hall awaiting appointee Chao Gongwu was made Sichuan pacification and pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔贈果州團練使韓崇嶽立廟，賜名忠勇，宣州觀察使朱勇立廟，賜名忠節。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, an edict ordered posthumous temples erected for Han Chongyue, military training commissioner of Guozhou, with the name Zhongyong, and for Zhu Yong, observer of Xuanzhou, with the name Zhongjie.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, an edict raised shrines to the late Guozhou training commissioner Han Chongyue, named Zhongyong, and Xuanzhou observer Zhu Yong, named Zhongjie.

sentences.zh: 己丑，四方霧下若塵。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, in the four directions fog descended like dust.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, dusty fog settled over the realm.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，蠲楚州壯丁、社民稅役。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, levies and corvée on militia youths and commune members in Chuzhou were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, taxes and labor duties on Chuzhou militia youths and commune households were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 諡陳亨伯曰湣節。

translations.literal: The posthumous title Minjie was granted to Chen Hengbo.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hengbo was given the posthumous name Minjie.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，置漢陽軍收發馬監。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day yiwei, a Hanyang Army office for receiving and dispatching horses was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yiwei day, a Hanyang Army horse receipt and dispatch office was created.

sentences.zh: 詔公吏非犯公罪，毋得引用並計案問法。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that clerks and subordinates who had not committed public crimes must not be prosecuted under the law for combined reckoning of cases.
translations.idiomatic: An edict barred using the combined-case reckoning statute against clerks and runners unless they had committed public crimes.

sentences.zh: 巳亥，置郢州轉般倉。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, a transport granary at Yingzhou was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, a Yingzhou relay granary was set up.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣使撫邛、蜀二州饑民爲亂者。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, envoys were sent to comfort the starving people who had risen in disorder in Qiong and Shu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, commissioners were dispatched to pacify famine rioters in Qiong and Shu.

sentences.zh: 己酉，追封韓世忠爲蘄王。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, posthumous enfeoffment of Han Shizhong as Prince of Qi was pursued.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Han Shizhong was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，蔣芾等上欽宗《帝紀》、《實錄》。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Jiang Fu and others presented the "Imperial Annals" and "Veritable Records" of Emperor Qinzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Jiang Fu and others submitted Emperor Qinzong’s Imperial Annals and Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，禮部員外郎李燾上所著《續通鑒長編》自建隆至治平一百八卷。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Li Tao, outer-office director of the Ministry of Rites, presented his work, the "Extended Comprehensive Mirror in Continuation," in one hundred eight juan from Jianlong through Zhiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Ministry of Rites outer-office director Li Tao submitted his Extended Comprehensive Mirror in Continuation, 108 juan covering Jianlong through Zhiping.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔太史局參用新舊曆。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, an edict ordered the Astronomical Bureau to use both the new and old calendars together.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, an edict told the Astronomical Bureau to employ the new and old calendars in parallel.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔販牛過淮者，論如興販軍須之罪。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, an edict ordered that those who sold cattle across the Huai be punished under the statute for illicitly trafficking military necessities.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, an edict made selling cattle south of the Huai punishable like trafficking military supplies.

sentences.zh: 是月，振綿、漢等州饑。

translations.literal: This month, relief was extended for famine in Mian, Han, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That month, famine relief was given in Mian, Han, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，出度牒千道，續減四川科調。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guihai, one thousand quota certificates were issued to continue reducing Sichuan’s assessed levies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guihai day, a thousand quota certificates were issued to further cut Sichuan’s tax assessments.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 以邛州安仁縣荒旱，失於蠲放，致饑民擾亂，守、貳、縣令降罷追停有差。

translations.literal: Because Anren County in Qiongzhou had suffered drought and famine and remission had been neglected, causing starving people to riot, the prefect, vice prefect, and county magistrate were demoted and dismissed to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Drought and famine in Qiongzhou’s Anren County had gone unremitted, provoking a food riot; the prefect, vice prefect, and magistrate were demoted or removed in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 甲申，諡趙鼎曰忠簡。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the posthumous title Zhongjian was granted to Zhao Ding.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Zhao Ding was given the posthumous name Zhongjian.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，行乾道新曆。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the new Qian Dao calendar was put into use.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the new Qian Dao calendar took effect.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以饒、信二州、建甯府饑民嘯聚，遣官措置振濟。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, because starving people in Rao and Xin prefectures and Jianning Prefecture had gathered and clamored, officials were sent to arrange relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, famine crowds in Rao and Xin and Jianning prompted commissioners to organize relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，西夏任敬德遣使至四川宣撫司，約發兵攻西番。

translations.literal: This month, Ren Jingde of Western Xia sent envoys to the Sichuan Pacification Commission proposing a joint attack on the Western Barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Western Xia’s Ren Jingde sent envoys to the Sichuan Pacification Commission proposing a joint strike on the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯朔，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the new moon day xinmao, Venus was visible in daytime and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the xinmao new moon, Venus shone by day and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔罷廣西鈔鹽，復官般官賣法，歲減轉運司鈔錢十九萬緡，其秋苗毋得科折。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, an edict abolished Guangxi salt certificates and restored the government transport and government sale method; the transport commission’s annual salt-certificate money was reduced by one hundred ninety thousand strings, and autumn grain must not be commuted or discounted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, an edict ended Guangxi salt coupons, restored state transport and sale of salt, cut the transport office’s annual coupon levy by 190,000 strings, and forbade discounting autumn grain taxes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，蠲諸路逋負乾道元年二月和市、折帛、雜色錢。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, arrears on market-purchase, silk-folding, and miscellaneous levies from the second month of the first year of Qian Dao on all circuits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, overdue market, silk, and miscellaneous levies dating from Qian Dao 1, month 2 were forgiven on every circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，龍大淵卒，詔以爲甯武軍節度使致仕。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Long Dayuan died; an edict made him military commissioner of Ningwu with permission to retire.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Long Dayuan died and was posthumously named Ningwu military commissioner in retirement.

sentences.zh: 五星皆見。

translations.literal: All five planets were visible.
translations.idiomatic: All five planets appeared together.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔四川宣撫司增印錢引一百萬，對償民間預借錢。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, an edict ordered the Sichuan Pacification Commission to print an additional one million cash notes to offset advance loans taken from the populace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, an edict authorized the Sichuan Pacification Commission to print another million cash notes to repay private advance loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲邛、蜀二州夏稅。

translations.literal: Summer tax in Qiong and Shu prefectures was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Summer taxes in Qiong and Shu were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，召興化軍布衣林彖赴行在。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the commoner Lin Lu of Xinghua Army was summoned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Xinghua Army commoner Lin Lu was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 戊午，蔣芾以母喪去位。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Jiang Fu left office on account of his mother’s death.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Jiang Fu resigned to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，以劉珙兼參知政事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day renxu, Liu Gong was also made Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renxu day, Liu Gong was also appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 召建甯府布衣魏掞之赴行在。

translations.literal: The commoner Wei Shanzhi of Jianning Prefecture was summoned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Jianning commoner Wei Shanzhi was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 申禁異服異樂。

translations.literal: Strange dress and strange music were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Outlandish clothing and music were banned.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，徽州大水。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Huizhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Huizhou was struck by severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 己巳，罷沿江水軍制置司。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Along-River Naval Forces Pacification Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the along-river naval pacification office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛未，衢州大水。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Quzhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Quzhou suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，知衢州王悅以盛暑禱雨、蔬食減膳、尤勤致疾而死，贈直龍圖閣。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Wang Yue, prefect of Quzhou, died of illness brought on by praying for rain in extreme heat, eating vegetables, and reducing his meals with especial diligence; he was posthumously granted the rank of Directly Attendant Gentleman of the Dragon Diagram Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Quzhou prefect Wang Yue died from illness incurred while fasting and eating sparingly as he prayed fervently for rain in fierce heat; he was posthumously made Directly Attendant Gentleman of the Dragon Diagram Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以經、總制餘剩錢二十一萬緡樁留邛、蜀州，以備振濟。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, two hundred ten thousand strings of surplus funds from the general and overall fiscal offices were set aside at Qiong and Shu prefectures for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, 210,000 strings of surplus general and overall fiscal funds were reserved at Qiong and Shu for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以久雨，御延和殿慮囚，減臨安府、三衙死罪以下囚，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, because of prolonged rain, the emperor went to the Yanhe Hall to review prisoners, reducing sentences below death in Lin’an Prefecture and the Three Yamen, and releasing those below the rod.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, prolonged rains led the emperor to the Yanhe Hall to review prisoners, commuting non-capital sentences in Lin’an and the Three Yamen and freeing those below flogging.

sentences.zh: 是月，西夏遣間使來。

translations.literal: This month, Western Xia sent secret envoys.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Western Xia sent covert envoys.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，班祈雨雪之法于諸路。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yiwei, the method for praying for rain and snow was promulgated to all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yiwei day, rain-and-snow prayer rites were issued to all circuits.

sentences.zh: 己亥，五星皆見。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, all five planets were visible.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, all five planets appeared.

sentences.zh: 丁未，主管殿前司公事王琪傳旨不實，擅興工役，降三官放罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Wang Qi, chief administrator of the Palace Front Division, was found to have transmitted imperial intent inaccurately and to have launched labor projects on his own authority; he was demoted three ranks and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Palace Front Division chief Wang Qi was demoted three ranks and dismissed for misreporting imperial orders and launching projects on his own.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，劉珙罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Liu Gong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Liu Gong left office.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，陳俊卿請罷政，不許。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Chen Junqing requested dismissal from government; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Chen Junqing asked to leave the council, but was refused.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，立內外將佐升差審察法。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day gengshen, regulations were established for promotion and review of officers and generals inside and outside the court.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengshen day, rules were set for examining and promoting military officers inside and outside the court.

sentences.zh: 庚午，從太上皇幸天竺寺。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the emperor accompanied the Retired Emperor to Tianzhu Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, he accompanied the retired emperor to Tianzhu Temple.

sentences.zh: 限品官子孫名田。

translations.literal: Limits were placed on land held in the names of officials’ children and grandchildren.
translations.idiomatic: Landholding by officials’ descendants was capped.

sentences.zh: 是秋，罷關外四州營田官兵，募民耕佃。

translations.literal: This autumn, military farm troops in the four prefectures beyond the passes were abolished, and tenants were recruited to farm and rent the land.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, army farmers in the four frontier prefectures were disbanded and the fields opened to civilian tenants.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰，遣鄭聞等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day renchen, Zheng Wen and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the renchen day, Zheng Wen and others were sent to the Jin for New Year felicitations.

sentences.zh: 甲午，禁歸正人藏匿金人者。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, persons of Guizheng status who concealed Jin people were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Guizheng clients who hid Jin subjects were outlawed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，臣僚言：「天下之事，必曆而後知，試而後見。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, officials memorialized: "Affairs under Heaven must be experienced before they are understood, and tested before they are seen.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, officials submitted: "Nothing under Heaven is understood until it has been experienced, or known until it has been tried.

sentences.zh: 爲縣令者必爲丞簿，爲郡守者必爲通判，爲監司者必爲郡守，皆有等差。

translations.literal: One who is to be a county magistrate must first serve as registrar or aide; one who is to be a prefect must first serve as vice prefect; one who is to be a circuit intendant must first serve as prefect—each with its proper gradation.
translations.idiomatic: Future magistrates must first serve as registrars or aides; future prefects as vice prefects; future intendants as prefects—each step in due order.

sentences.zh: 自今職事官及局務官，必任滿方許求外，未曆親民任使，即未得擬州郡，且授通判。

translations.literal: From now on, duty officials and bureau officials must complete their terms before they may seek outside posts; those who have not yet served in posts dealing directly with the people may not yet be nominated for prefectures and circuits, but are to be appointed vice prefects first."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth duty and bureau officials must finish their terms before seeking outside posts; those without experience governing the people may not be nominated to prefectures or circuits, but should first be made vice prefects."

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict followed this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 庚子，蔣芾起復尚書左僕射，陳俊卿右僕射，並同中書門下平章事兼樞密使兼制國用使。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Jiang Fu returned to duty as Minister of the Left, and Chen Junqing as Minister of the Right; both were Grand Councilors and concurrently Directors of Military Affairs and Commissioners for State Finances.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Jiang Fu resumed as Minister of the Left and Chen Junqing became Minister of the Right; both were grand councilors, military directors, and state-finance commissioners.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，大閱。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, a grand review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, a grand military review was held.

sentences.zh: 己酉，金遣移刺神獨斡等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the Jin sent Yelü Shenduwo and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, the Jin sent Yelü Shenduwo and others for the Joint Celebration Festival.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大風。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, a violent windstorm struck.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，遣知無爲軍徐子寅措置楚州官田，招集歸正忠義人以耕。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renxu, Xu Ziyin, prefect of Wuwei Army, was sent to arrange government fields at Chuzhou and recruit Guizheng loyalists to farm them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renxu day, Wuwei prefect Xu Ziyin was ordered to organize Chuzhou state land and settle loyal Guizheng farmers on it.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，嚴盜賊法。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the law on bandits and thieves was tightened.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, penalties for theft and banditry were stiffened.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔峽州布衣郭雍赴行在。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an edict summoned the commoner Guo Yong of Xiazhou to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, an edict called Xiazhou commoner Guo Yong to court.

sentences.zh: 壬申，兩淮歸正忠義有田產者，蠲役五年。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Guizheng loyalists on the two Huai circuits who possessed fields had corvée remitted for five years.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, loyal Guizheng settlers on the two Huai circuits who owned land had labor duties forgiven for five years.

sentences.zh: 癸未，岳陽軍節度使居廣封永陽郡王。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Ju Guang, military commissioner of Yueyang Army, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yongyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day, Yueyang military commissioner Ju Guang was enfeoffed as Prince of Yongyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，遣胡元質等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingshen, Hu Yuanzhi and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingshen day, Hu Yuanzhi and others were dispatched for the Jin emperor’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賜魏掞之同進士出身，爲太學錄。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Wei Shanzhi was granted status equal to a successful candidate in the same examination and made recorder of the Imperial College.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Wei Shanzhi was given jinshi standing and appointed Imperial College recorder.

sentences.zh: 蔣芾辭起復，許之。

translations.literal: Jiang Fu declined to return from mourning; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Fu declined to end mourning and return; permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 減兩浙、江東西路明年夏稅、和市之半。

translations.literal: Half of next year’s summer tax and market purchases in the two Zhe and Jiangdong and Jiangxi circuits were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Next year’s summer tax and market levies in the two Zhe circuits and Jiangdong and Jiangxi were cut by half.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，金遣完顏仲仁等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the Jin sent Wanyan Zhongren and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, the Jin sent Wanyan Zhongren and others for the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月甲戌，措置兩淮屯田。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the fifth year, on the day jiaxu, military farms on the two Huai circuits were arranged.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifth year, on the first month’s jiaxu day, garrison farming on the two Huai circuits was organized.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，申嚴太廟季點法。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jichou, the seasonal inspection law for the Imperial Ancestral Temple was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jichou day, the ancestral temple’s seasonal inspection rites were strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命楚州兵馬鈐轄羊滋專一措置沿淮、海盜賊。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Yang Zi, military controller at Chuzhou, was ordered to take sole charge of pirates along the Huai and the sea.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Chuzhou military controller Yang Zi was assigned exclusive responsibility for Huai and coastal pirates.

sentences.zh: 先是，海州人時旺聚衆數千來請命，旺尋爲金人所獲，其徒渡淮而南者甚衆，故命滋彈壓之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Shi Wang of Haizhou had gathered several thousand men to request appointment; Wang was soon captured by the Jin, and very many of his followers crossed the Huai southward; therefore Zi was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Haizhou’s Shi Wang had rallied several thousand men seeking enrollment; the Jin soon seized Wang, and many of his followers crossed the Huai south—hence the order for Zi to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，贈張浚太師，諡忠獻。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Zhang Jun was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and granted the posthumous title Zhongxian.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Zhang Jun was posthumously made Grand Preceptor with the name Zhongxian.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以給事中梁克家簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Liang Kejia of the Secretariat Reception Office was appointed to sign the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, Secretariat receptionist Liang Kejia was named to sign Military Affairs documents.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大風。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, a violent windstorm struck.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以王炎參知政事兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Wang Yan was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Wang Yan became Vice Director of the Secretariat and Associate Director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔自今詔令未經兩省書讀者毋輒行，給、舍駁正毋連銜同奏。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, an edict ordered that from now on edicts not yet read and countersigned by the two secretariats must not be carried out, and that drafting and editing officials in rebuttal must not jointly sign and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, an edict barred executing orders not yet read by both secretariats and forbade drafting and editing officers from joint rebuttal memorials.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳朔，詔趣修廬、和二州城。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the new moon day dingsi, an edict ordered expedited repair of the walls of Lu and He prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the dingsi new moon, an edict ordered urgent repairs to the walls of Lu and He.

sentences.zh: 己巳，蠲成都府路民戶歲輸對糴米腳錢三十五萬緡。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, thirty-five ten-thousands of strings in surcharge money for commuted grain deliveries by households in the Chengdu circuit were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, 350,000 strings in Chengdu circuit grain-commutation surcharges were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以王炎爲四川宣撫使，仍參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Wang Yan was made Sichuan Pacification Commissioner while retaining his post as Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Wang Yan was named Sichuan pacification commissioner while keeping his vice directorship.

sentences.zh: 召虞允文赴行在。

translations.literal: Yu Yunwen was summoned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賜禮部進土鄭僑以下三百九十有二人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, three hundred ninety-two persons including Zheng Qiao of the Ministry of Rites graduates were granted metropolitan degrees and status.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, 392 Ministry of Rites graduates including Zheng Qiao received metropolitan degrees and office.

sentences.zh: 壬午，賜郭雍號沖晦處士。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Guo Yong was granted the style Chonghui Recluse.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, Guo Yong was given the epithet Chonghui Recluse.

sentences.zh: 癸未。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day.

sentences.zh: 罷利州路諸州營田官兵，募民耕佃。

translations.literal: Military farm troops in the various prefectures of Lizhou Circuit were abolished, and tenants were recruited to farm and rent the land.
translations.idiomatic: Army farmers in Lizhou’s prefectures were disbanded and the land opened to civilian tenants.

sentences.zh: 詔侍從、監司、帥臣、管軍薦武舉出身人可將佐者。

translations.literal: An edict ordered attendants, circuit intendants, commanders, and army supervisors to recommend persons of military-examination origin fit to serve as officers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called on attendants, intendants, commanders, and army supervisors to nominate military-examination graduates fit for command.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己丑，復置將作、軍器少監。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jichou, the posts of Vice Director of the Directorate for Palace Buildings and Vice Director of the Armory were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jichou day, the vice directorships of Palace Buildings and the Armory were restored.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以梁克家兼參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Liang Kejia was also made Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Liang Kejia was also appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔福建路貧民生子，官給錢米。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, an edict ordered that in the Fujian circuit poor households bearing children be given money and grain by the state.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, an edict provided state money and grain to poor Fujian families at childbirth.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，修襄陽府城。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the walls of Xiangyang Prefecture were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Xiangyang’s walls were repaired.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，振恤衢、婺、饒、信四州流民。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, relief was extended to displaced persons in Qu, Wu, Rao, and Xin.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, refugees in Qu, Wu, Rao, and Xin were given relief.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，帝以射弩弦斷傷目，不視朝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jisi, because a crossbow string snapped while the emperor was shooting and injured his eye, he did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jisi day, a snapped crossbow string wounded the emperor’s eye, and he suspended court.

sentences.zh: 金牒取俘獲人，王抃議盡遣時旺餘黨，陳俊卿持不可，帝然之。

translations.literal: The Jin sent a note demanding the return of captives; Wang Kan proposed sending all of Shi Wang’s remaining followers; Chen Junqing held that this must not be done; the emperor agreed with him.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin demanded captives back; Wang Kan urged handing over all of Shi Wang’s remaining followers, but Chen Junqing objected, and the emperor sided with Chen.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengyin, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengyin day, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，始視朝。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the emperor again held court.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the emperor resumed court.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以虞允文爲樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Yu Yunwen was made Director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Yu Yunwen was appointed Director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，召曾覿入見，陳俊卿及虞允文請罷之，不許。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day yichou, Zeng Di was summoned for an audience; Chen Junqing and Yu Yunwen requested his dismissal; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yichou day, Zeng Di was summoned to court; Chen Junqing and Yu Yunwen asked that he be removed, but were refused.

sentences.zh: 至行在，俊卿、允文復言其不可留，詔以覿爲浙東總管。

translations.literal: When he reached the mobile court, Junqing and Yunwen again said he could not be retained; an edict made Di supreme commander of Zhedong.
translations.idiomatic: After Di reached court, Chen and Yu again protested his retention; an edict posted him as Zhedong supreme commander instead.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the new moon day jiashen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiashen new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以陳俊卿爲尚書左僕射，虞允文爲尚書右僕射，並同中書門下平章事兼樞密使兼制國用使，辛亥，命淮西路鑄小鐵錢。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Chen Junqing was made Minister of the Left and Yu Yunwen Minister of the Right; both were Grand Councilors and concurrently Directors of Military Affairs and Commissioners for State Finances. On the day xinhai, the Huai West circuit was ordered to cast small iron cash.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Chen Junqing became Minister of the Left and Yu Yunwen Minister of the Right, both grand councilors, military directors, and finance commissioners. On the xinhai day, Huai West was ordered to mint small iron coins.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，罷淮東屯田官兵，募民耕佃。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiwei, military farm troops in Huai East were abolished, and tenants were recruited to farm and rent the land.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiwei day, Huai East army farmers were disbanded and fields leased to civilians.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔淮東諸州農隙教閱民丁。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, an edict ordered Huai East prefectures to drill militia youths in the agricultural off-season.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, an edict required Huai East prefectures to train militia in the farming slack season.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔侍從、臺諫集議欽宗配饗功臣。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, an edict ordered attendants and censors to meet and discuss the meritorious officials to share in sacrifices to Emperor Qinzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, an edict told attendants and censors to deliberate which meritorious officials should share Qinzong’s sacrificial honors.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大風。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, a violent windstorm struck.

sentences.zh: 命淮西安撫司參議官許子中措置淮西山水砦，招集歸正忠義人耕墾官田。

translations.literal: Xu Zizhong, deliberator of the Huai West Pacification Commission, was ordered to arrange mountain-and-water stockades in Huai West and recruit Guizheng loyalists to reclaim government fields.
translations.idiomatic: Huai West pacification deliberator Xu Zizhong was told to organize frontier stockades and settle loyal Guizheng farmers on state land.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，遣汪大猷等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day yiyou, Wang Dayou and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the yiyou day, Wang Dayou and others were dispatched to the Jin for New Year felicitations.

sentences.zh: 戊子，振溫、台二州被水貧民，以守臣、監司失職，降責有差。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, relief was extended to the poor of Wen and Tai prefectures who had suffered flooding; because the prefectural officials and circuit intendants had failed in their duties, they were demoted and reprimanded to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, flood victims in Wen and Tai were relieved, while negligent prefects and intendants were demoted or censured in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大風。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, a violent windstorm struck.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命饒、信二州歲各留上供米三萬石，以備振糶。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Rao and Xin prefectures were each ordered to retain thirty thousand piculs of tribute grain annually for relief sales.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, Rao and Xin were each told to hold back 30,000 piculs of annual tribute grain for famine sales.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，金遣高德基等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the Jin sent Gao Deji and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day, the Jin sent Gao Deji and others for the Joint Celebration Festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑朔，復置淮東萬弩手，名神勁軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the new moon day guichou, the Huai East corps of ten-thousand crossbowmen was restored, named the Divine Stalwart Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guichou new moon, Huai East’s ten-thousand crossbow corps was restored as the Divine Stalwart Army.

sentences.zh: 庚申，增置廣東水軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the Guangdong naval forces were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, Guangdong naval forces were expanded.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以孫擴爲右千牛衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Sun Kuo was made Grand General of the Right Thousand-Ox Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Sun Kuo was appointed Grand General of the Right Thousand-Ox Gate.

sentences.zh: 以明州定海縣水軍爲御前水軍。

translations.literal: The naval forces of Dinghai County in Mingzhou were made an imperial front naval force.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzhou’s Dinghai naval detachment became an imperial front fleet.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，爲岳飛立廟于鄂州。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, a temple to Yue Fei was erected at Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, a shrine to Yue Fei was raised at Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔侍從、臺諫、兩省官，各舉京朝官以上、才堪監司、郡守者三人。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, an edict ordered attendants, censors, and members of the two palace secretariats each to recommend three metropolitan officials and above fit for circuit intendant or prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, an edict required attendants, censors, and secretariat officials each to nominate three capital officials fit for intendant or prefect.

sentences.zh: 壬申，復成閔慶遠軍節度使、鎮江諸軍都統制。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Cheng Min was restored as military commissioner of Minqing and Yuan armies and commander-in-chief of the armies at Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Cheng Min was reinstated as Minqing-Yuan military commissioner and Zhenjiang commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，遣司馬伋等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jichou, Sima Kan and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jichou day, Sima Kan and others were sent for the Jin emperor’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大風。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, a violent windstorm struck.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，置應城縣馬監。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, a horse office was established in Yingcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, a Yingcheng County horse office was created.

sentences.zh: 復李顯忠威武軍節度使。

translations.literal: Li Xianzhong was restored as military commissioner of the Weiwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xianzhong was reinstated as Weiwu Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復置成都府廣惠倉。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Broad Relief Granary of Chengdu Prefecture was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Chengdu’s Broad Relief Granary was restored.

sentences.zh: 戊申，金遣完顏毅等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the Jin sent Wanyan Yi and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, the Jin sent Wanyan Yi and others for the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸丑，雅州沙平蠻寇邊，焚碉緬砦。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the sixth year, on the day guichou, the Shaping barbarians of Yazhou raided the border, burning stockade forts.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the sixth year, on the first month’s guichou day, Yazhou’s Shaping tribes raided the frontier and burned stockades.

sentences.zh: 四川制置使晁公武調兵討之，失利。

translations.literal: Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Chao Gongwu mobilized troops to attack them and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Chao Gongwu marched against them and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，修楚州城。

translations.literal: On the day maomao, the walls of Chuzhou were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On the maomao day, Chuzhou’s walls were repaired.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，復強盜舊法，其四年十一月指揮勿行。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the old law on bandits and robbers was restored; the directive of the eleventh month of the fourth year was not to be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, the former banditry statute was restored and the fourth-year, eleventh-month order set aside.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，初降金字牌下四川宣撫司，備邊奏。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, gold-letter plaques were first sent down to the Sichuan Pacification Commission for frontier memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, gold-letter plaques were first issued to the Sichuan Pacification Commission for frontier reports.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，增築豐儲倉。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the Abundant Stores Granary was enlarged.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, the Abundant Stores Granary was expanded.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以奉國軍承宣使、知廬州郭振爲武泰軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Guo Zhen, commissioner of the Fengguo Army and prefect of Luzhou, was made military commissioner of the Wutai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Fengguo commissioner and Luzhou prefect Guo Zhen became Wutai military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，詔戶部侍郎二人分領諸路財賦。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yiyou, an edict ordered two vice ministers of the Ministry of Revenue to divide supervision of revenues on all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yiyou day, an edict split fiscal oversight on all circuits between two revenue vice ministers.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，復置舒州同安監，鑄鐵錢。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Tong’an mint in Shuzhou was restored to cast iron cash.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Shuzhou’s Tong’an mint was restored for iron coinage.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，王炎遣人約沙平蠻歸部，稍損邊稅與之。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Wang Yan sent men to induce the Shaping barbarians to return to their territories, slightly reducing border levies for them.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Wang Yan sent envoys to bring the Shaping tribes back, trimming border taxes slightly in return.

sentences.zh: 丙申，廣西路復行鈔鹽法，仍增收通貨錢四十萬緡，以備漕計。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the Guangxi circuit again implemented the salt-certificate method, also increasing circulating-money levies by four hundred thousand strings to supply transport accounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Guangxi resumed salt coupons and added 400,000 strings in circulation levies for transport funds.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔諭大臣：均役法，嚴限田，抑游手，務農桑。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, an edict instructed the chief ministers: equalize corvée law, strictly limit landholding, restrain idlers, and promote mulberry and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, an edict told the chief ministers to enforce equal corvée, cap estates, curb idlers, and promote farming and sericulture.

sentences.zh: 己酉，置應城縣孳生監。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, a breeding horse office was established in Yingcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, a Yingcheng breeding stud was established.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以曾覿爲福州觀察使。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Zeng Di was made observer of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, Zeng Di was appointed Fuzhou observer.

sentences.zh: 遣司農寺丞許子中詣淮西，措置鐵錢。

translations.literal: Commissioner of the Court of the Imperial Granaries Xu Zizhong was sent to Huai West to arrange iron cash.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Granary commissioner Xu Zizhong was dispatched to Huai West to organize iron currency.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，用三省言，兩淮守帥宜久其任，二年後察其能否，以行賞罰。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guichou, following a memorial from the Three Departments, it was ordered that commanders on the two Huai circuits should hold office for extended terms; after two years their competence would be examined and rewards and punishments applied.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the guichou day, the Three Departments urged long tenures for the two Huai commanders, with review and rewards or penalties after two years.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，裁減樞密院吏額一百十有四人。

translations.literal: On the day maomao, the clerk establishment of the Bureau of Military Affairs was cut by one hundred fourteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: On the maomao day, Military Affairs clerical staff was reduced by 114 posts.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔步軍司權以三萬五千人爲額。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, an edict temporarily fixed the Infantry Bureau establishment at thirty-five thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, an edict set the Infantry Bureau quota at 35,000 men.

sentences.zh: 起復王抃僉知閣門事，專一措置三衙揀選官兵。

translations.literal: Wang Kan was recalled from mourning to serve as vice commissioner of the Gate, with sole charge of selecting troops in the Three Yamen.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Kan was recalled from mourning as vice gate commissioner to oversee Three Yamen troop selection.

sentences.zh: 贈彰國軍節度使大周仁爲太尉。

translations.literal: Da Zhouren, military commissioner of the Zhangguo Army, was posthumously made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Late Zhangguo military commissioner Da Zhouren was posthumously made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 庚申，從太上皇、太上皇后幸聚景園。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the emperor accompanied the Retired Emperor and the Retired Empress to Jujing Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, he accompanied the retired emperor and retired empress to Jujing Garden.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以晁公武、王炎不協，罷四川制置司歸宣撫司。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, because Chao Gongwu and Wang Yan were at odds, the Sichuan Pacification Commission was abolished and its duties returned to the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, discord between Chao Gongwu and Wang Yan led to abolishing the Sichuan Pacification Commission and restoring a single pacification headquarters.

sentences.zh: 辛未，從太上皇、太上皇后幸聚景園。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the emperor again accompanied the Retired Emperor and the Retired Empress to Jujing Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, he again accompanied the retired emperor and retired empress to Jujing Garden.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，裁減三省吏額七十人。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the clerk establishment of the Three Departments was cut by seventy persons.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Three Departments clerical staff was cut by 70 posts.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以知紹興府史浩爲檢校少傅、保甯軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Shi Hao, prefect of Shaoxing, was made Acting Junior Tutor and military commissioner of the Baoning Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Shaoxing prefect Shi Hao was made acting Junior Tutor and Baoning military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔兩淮州縣官以繁簡易其任。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, an edict ordered that prefectural and county officials on the two Huai circuits be assigned according to whether their posts were heavy or light.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, an edict matched Huai circuit officials to posts by workload.

sentences.zh: 復置江、浙、京湖、兩廣、福建等路都大發運使，以新知成都府史正志爲之。

translations.literal: The post of Grand Transport Commissioner for the Jiang, Zhe, Jing-Hu, the two Guang, and Fujian circuits was restored; the newly appointed prefect of Chengdu, Shi Zhengzhi, was made commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The grand transport commission for Jiang, Zhe, Jing-Hu, the two Guang, and Fujian was restored, with new Chengdu prefect Shi Zhengzhi as commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳朔，罷鑄錢司歸發運司。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the new moon day xinsi, the Coinage Office was abolished and returned to the Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinsi new moon, the Coinage Office was merged back into the Transport Commission.

sentences.zh: 並淮東總領所歸淮西總領所。

translations.literal: The Huai East chief steward office was merged into the Huai West chief steward office.
translations.idiomatic: Huai East’s chief steward office was absorbed into Huai West’s.

sentences.zh: 以敷文閣直學士張震知成都府，充本路安撫使，乙未，賜發運使史正志緡錢二百萬，爲均輸、和糴之用。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhen, direct academician of the Fuweng Hall, was made prefect of Chengdu and pacification commissioner of that circuit. On the day yiwei, Transport Commissioner Shi Zhengzhi was granted two million strings in cash for equalized transport and harmonized grain purchases.
translations.idiomatic: Fuweng Hall academician Zhang Zhen became Chengdu prefect and circuit pacification commissioner. On the yiwei day, Transport Commissioner Shi Zhengzhi received two million strings for equalized shipping and state grain purchases.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書汪應辰三上疏論發運司。

translations.literal: Wang Yingchen, Minister of Personnel, memorialized three times criticizing the Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel Minister Wang Yingchen submitted three memorials attacking the transport office.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以應辰知平江府。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Yingchen was made prefect of Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Wang Yingchen was posted as Pingjiang prefect.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，裁減六部吏額百五十人，其餘百司、三衙以是爲差。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jiayin, the clerk establishment of the Six Ministries was cut by one hundred fifty persons; the remaining hundred offices and Three Yamen were reduced proportionally.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiayin day, Six Ministries clerks were cut by 150 posts, with other agencies and the Three Yamen reduced proportionally.

sentences.zh: 己未，陳俊卿、虞允文等上神宗、哲宗、徽宗、欽宗四朝《會要》、太上皇玉牒。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Chen Junqing, Yu Yunwen, and others presented the "Compendium" of Shenzong, Zhezong, Huizong, and Qinzong and the jade register of the Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Chen Junqing, Yu Yunwen, and others submitted the Four Reigns Compendium and the retired emperor’s jade register.

sentences.zh: 已已，陳俊卿以議遣使不合，罷爲觀文殿大學士、知福州。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Chen Junqing was dismissed for disagreeing over sending envoys and was made Grand Master of the Palace for Glorious Culture and prefect of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Chen Junqing was removed for opposing an embassy and made Glorious Culture palace academician and Fuzhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 罷行在至鎮江徵稅所比近者十有三。

translations.literal: Thirteen tax posts near the mobile court and Zhenjiang were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen tax stations near court and Zhenjiang were shut down.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔戒飭百官。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, an edict admonished all officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, an edict warned all officials to reform.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，知潮州曾造犯贓，貸命、南雄州編管，籍其家。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Zeng Zao, prefect of Chaozhou, committed bribery; his life was spared, he was registered in Nanxiongzhou, and his household registers were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Chaozhou prefect Zeng Zao was convicted of graft, spared execution, exiled to Nanxiong, and his property forfeited.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔給舍、臺諫言事。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, an edict ordered drafting, editing, and censorial officials to speak on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, an edict invited drafting, editing, and censorial officers to speak freely.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，申嚴卿監、郎官更迭補外之制。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renzi, the system of rotating ministers and vice ministers and bureau directors and section chiefs to outside posts was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the renzi day, rotation of ministers, vice ministers, directors, and section chiefs to outside posts was strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 壬申，增武學生爲百人。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, military students were increased to one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, military academy enrollment was raised to 100.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，置蘄州蘄春監、黃州齊安監，鑄鐵錢。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Qizhou’s Qichun mint and Huangzhou’s Qi’an mint were established to cast iron cash.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Qichun and Qi’an mints were set up in Qizhou and Huangzhou for iron coinage.

sentences.zh: 是月，榮國公挺自東宮出居外第。
