translations.literal: This month, Duke of Rongguo Ting moved out of the Eastern Palace to an outer residence.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Duke of Rongguo Ting left the Eastern Palace for an outer residence.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，詔以沙田、蘆場歲收租稅六十餘萬緡入左藏南庫。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day guiwei, an edict ordered that the more than six hundred ten-thousands of strings in annual rent and tax from sand fields and reed flats be paid into the Southern Treasury of the Left Vault.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guiwei day, an edict directed over 600,000 strings in annual sand-flat and reed-bed rents into the Left Vault’s southern treasury.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔川廣監司、郡守任滿奏事訖方調。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, an edict ordered that circuit intendants and prefects in Sichuan and the broad south must memorialize on completing their terms before transfer.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, an edict required Sichuan and southern intendants and prefects to report before transfer at term’s end.

sentences.zh: 己丑，置興國軍興國監。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the Xingguo mint in Xingguo Army was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, an Xingguo Army mint was established.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔除郎官並引對畢供職。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, an edict ordered that after audience all section chiefs take up their duties.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, an edict required new section chiefs to assume duty after audience.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復置御前弓馬子弟所，命吳挺兼提舉。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the Imperial Bow-and-Horse Youth Institute was restored; Wu Ting was ordered to supervise it concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, the imperial bow-and-horse youth institute was restored under Wu Ting’s supervision.

sentences.zh: 賜岳飛廟曰忠烈。

translations.literal: The Yue Fei temple was granted the name Zhonglie.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei’s shrine was named Zhonglie.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，虞允文請蚤建太子。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengxu, Yu Yunwen requested that the heir be established early.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengxu day, Yu Yunwen urged an early choice of crown prince.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，復置詳定一司敕令所。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Office for Detailed Determination of Statutes and Commands for a Single Department was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the single-department statute-review office was restored.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，置閣門舍人十員。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, ten gate secretariat attendants were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, ten gate secretariat attendants were added.

sentences.zh: 是月，虞允文上《乾道敕令格式》。

translations.literal: This month, Yu Yunwen presented the "Qian Dao Statutes, Commands, and Formats."
translations.idiomatic: That month, Yu Yunwen submitted the Qian Dao Statutes, Commands, and Formats.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，賜蘇軾諡曰文忠。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renchen, Su Shi was granted the posthumous title Wenzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renchen day, Su Shi was given the posthumous name Wenzhong.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，沅州徭人相仇殺，守臣孫叔傑出兵擊之，失利。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Yao people in Yuanzhou feuded and killed one another; the prefect Sun Shujie led troops to attack them and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, Yuanzhou Yao clans blood-feuded; prefect Sun Shujie attacked them and lost.

sentences.zh: 徭人進迫州城，安撫司諭解之，叔傑尋抵罪。

translations.literal: The Yao pressed on the prefectural city; the Pacification Commission admonished them and they dispersed; Shujie was soon punished.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao besieged the prefectural seat until the pacification office talked them down; Shujie was soon punished.

sentences.zh: 是月，范成大至自金，金許以遷奉及歸欽廟梓宮，而不易受書禮。

translations.literal: This month, Fan Chengda returned from the Jin; the Jin agreed to the transfer of burial honors and the return of Qinzong’s coffin, but would not readily accept changes in letter ritual.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Fan Chengda returned from the Jin with agreement to move imperial remains and return Qinzong’s coffin, but not to alter letter protocol.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，以孫攄爲左千牛衛大將軍。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiyou, Sun Kuo was made Grand General of the Left Thousand-Ox Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiyou day, Sun Kuo was appointed Grand General of the Left Thousand-Ox Gate.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔發運使置司行在。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict ordered the transport commissioner to establish his office at the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, an edict placed the transport commissioner’s headquarters at court.

sentences.zh: 諡司馬樸曰忠潔。

translations.literal: The posthumous title Zhongjie was granted to Sima Pu.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Pu was given the posthumous name Zhongjie.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，遣呂正己等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Lü Zhengzhi and others were sent as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Lü Zhengzhi and others were sent to the Jin for New Year felicitations.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，金遣耶律子敬等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the Jin sent Yelü Zijing and others to congratulate the Joint Celebration Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the Jin sent Yelü Zijing and others for the Joint Celebration Festival.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，起居舍人趙雄請置局議恢復，詔以雄爲中書舍人。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Attendance Recorder Zhao Xiong requested that a bureau be established to discuss restoration; an edict made Xiong a Secretariat drafter.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Attendance Recorder Zhao Xiong urged a restoration planning bureau and was made Secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑朔，復置軍器監一員。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the new moon day dingchou, one post of Director of the Armory was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the dingchou new moon, the Armory directorship was restored.

sentences.zh: 壬午，合祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Heaven and Earth were worshiped together at the Round Mound, and a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, a combined sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was held at the Round Mound and a general amnesty declared.

sentences.zh: 乙未，復置神武中軍，以吳挺爲都統制。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the Divine Martial Central Army was restored, with Wu Ting as commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, the Divine Martial Central Army was restored under Wu Ting.

sentences.zh: 召曾覿提舉佑神觀。

translations.literal: Zeng Di was summoned to direct the You Shen Observatory.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Di was recalled to head the You Shen Observatory.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，加上光堯壽聖太上皇帝尊號曰光堯壽聖憲天體道太上皇帝、壽聖太上皇后尊號曰壽聖明慈太上皇后。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, honorific titles were added for the Retired Emperor Guangyao Shousheng and the Retired Empress Shousheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, augmented honorific titles were bestowed on the retired emperor and retired empress.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣趙雄等賀金主生辰，別函書請更受書之禮。

translations.literal: This month, Zhao Xiong and others were sent to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday, with a separate letter requesting acceptance of revised letter ritual.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhao Xiong and others were sent for the Jin emperor’s birthday bearing a separate note asking acceptance of revised letter ritual.

sentences.zh: 置左藏南上庫。

translations.literal: The Upper Southern Treasury of the Left Vault was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Vault’s upper southern treasury was established.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，大閱。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wushen, a grand review was held.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wushen day, a grand military review was held.

sentences.zh: 甲子，置江州廣寧監、臨江軍豐餘監、撫州裕國監鑄鐵錢。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, iron-coin mints were established at Jiangzhou’s Guangning, Linjiang Army’s Fengyu, and Fuzhou’s Yuguo.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, iron mints were opened at Jiangzhou Guangning, Linjiang Fengyu, and Fuzhou Yuguo.

sentences.zh: 壬申，金遣蒲察願等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the Jin sent Pucha Yuan and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, the Jin sent Pucha Yuan and others for the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，罷發運司。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the Transport Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, the Transport Commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 以史正志奏課不實，責爲楚州團練副使、永州安置。

translations.literal: Because Shi Zhengzhi’s memorial on tax yields was false, he was demoted to deputy military training commissioner of Chuzhou and settled in Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zhengzhi was demoted to Chuzhou deputy commissioner and confined at Yongzhou for falsifying revenue reports.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩浙、江東西、福建水、旱。

translations.literal: This year, the two Zhe circuits and Jiangdong and Jiangxi suffered flood and drought; Fujian suffered flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: That year the two Zhe circuits and Jiangdong and Jiangxi saw flood and drought, as did Fujian.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月丙子，率群臣奉上太上皇、太上皇后冊寶于德壽宮。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the seventh year, on the day bingzi, the emperor led the hundred officials in presenting seals and regalia to the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress at Deshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the seventh year, on the first month’s bingzi day, the emperor led officials to present seals and regalia to the retired emperor and empress at Deshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，虞允文復請建太子，帝命允文擬詔以進。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Yu Yunwen again requested establishment of the heir; the emperor ordered Yunwen to draft an edict for submission.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, Yu Yunwen again urged naming an heir, and the emperor told him to draft the edict.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命三省旬錄宣諭聖語及時政記同進。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the Three Departments were ordered each ten days to record imperial instructions and current-affairs notes and submit them together.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the Three Departments were told to log imperial words and current-affairs notes every ten days and submit them jointly.

sentences.zh: 是月，復鑄錢司。

translations.literal: This month, the Coinage Office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Coinage Office was restored.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，詔立子惇爲皇太子，大赦。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day guichou, an edict proclaimed the son Dun as Crown Prince and granted a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the guichou day, an edict named Dun crown prince and ordered a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 以慶王愷爲雄武、保甯軍節度使、判甯國府，進封魏王。

translations.literal: Prince Qing Kai was appointed military commissioner of the Xiongwu and Baoning Armies and administrator of Ningguo Prefecture, and was advanced to Prince of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qing Kai was made commissioner of the Xiongwu and Baoning Armies and prefect of Ningguo, and promoted to Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，增置皇太子宮講讀官。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, lecturing and reading officials for the Crown Prince's Palace were added.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, additional tutors were appointed to the crown prince's household.

sentences.zh: 庚申，罷會子庫，仍賜戶部內藏南庫緡錢二百萬、銀九十萬兩，以增給官兵之奉。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the Huizi Treasury was abolished; still granted from the Ministry of Revenue inner reserve southern treasury two million strings of cash and nine hundred thousand taels of silver to increase the stipends of officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, the Huizi Treasury was abolished, but two million strings of cash and nine hundred thousand taels of silver from the revenue ministry's inner southern vault were allotted to raise army pay.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔寺觀毋免稅役。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, an edict ordered that temples and monasteries not be exempt from tax and corvée obligations.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, an edict ended tax and corvée exemptions for temples and abbeys.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太傅、大寧郡王吳益薨。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Grand Mentor and Prince of Daning Wu Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, Grand Mentor Wu Yi, Prince of Daning, died.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大風。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, a fierce windstorm struck.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥朔，趙雄至金，金拒其請。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day of the month yihai, Zhao Xiong reached the Jin; the Jin rejected his request.
translations.idiomatic: On the third month's yihai new moon, Zhao Xiong reached Jin territory, but the Jin refused his petition.

sentences.zh: 詔訓習水軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered training of the riverine forces.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the navy drilled.

sentences.zh: 丙子，立恭王夫人李氏爲皇太子妃。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Lady Li, consort of Prince Gong, was established as Crown Princess.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, Lady Li, wife of Prince Gong, was installed as crown princess.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，徙侍衛馬軍司戍建康。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, the Imperial Horse Guards Command garrison was transferred to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the imperial horse guards were posted to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，起復劉珙同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Liu Gong was recalled from mourning to serve as vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Liu Gong was recalled from mourning as vice commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 以明州觀察使、知閣門事兼樞密都承旨張說簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Zhang Shuo, observation commissioner of Mingzhou, commissioner of the Palace Gate Office, and chief secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed to sign documents at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shuo, Mingzhou commissioner and chief secretary of military affairs, was appointed deputy commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 左司員外郎兼侍講張栻言說不宜執政。

translations.literal: Left Section assistant department director and court lecturer Zhang Shi stated that Shuo was not fit to hold power in government.
translations.idiomatic: Left Section assistant director and lecturer Zhang Shi argued that Zhang Shuo should not serve in the chief council.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，立沿海州軍私齎銅錢下海船法。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the law on coastal prefectures and armies privately carrying copper cash on ships going to sea was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, regulations were enacted forbidding coastal commands from letting private ships carry copper coin to sea.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，復置將作監。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Directorate of Palace Buildings was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the Directorate of Palace Buildings was reinstated.

sentences.zh: 殿中侍御史李處全乞遣張說按行邊戍，以息衆論，中書舍人范成大乞不草詞。

translations.literal: Palace censor Li Chuquan requested that Zhang Shuo be sent to inspect the frontier garrisons to quiet popular talk; Secretariat drafter Fan Chengda requested not to draft the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Li Chuquan asked that Zhang Shuo tour the border garrisons to allay public criticism, while Fan Chengda refused to draft the appointment.

sentences.zh: 戊子，說罷爲安慶軍節度使、提舉萬壽觀。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Shuo was dismissed and made military commissioner of the Anqing Army and supervisor of Wanshou Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Zhang Shuo was removed and posted as Anqing commissioner with a sinecure at Wanshou Abbey.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，遣使核兩淮種麥。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, envoys were dispatched to verify wheat planting in the two Huai circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, inspectors were sent to check wheat sowing in the two Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 丙申，御大慶殿冊皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the emperor ascended the Hall of Great Celebration to invest the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, the emperor invested the crown prince in the Hall of Great Celebration.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎鄭聞、工部侍郎胡銓、樞密院檢詳文字李衡、秘書丞潘慈明並罷。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Zheng Wen, Vice Minister of Works Hu Quan, Bureau of Military Affairs document examiner Li Heng, and Secretariat Director Pan Ciming were all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Wen, Hu Quan, Li Heng, and Pan Ciming were all removed from their posts.

sentences.zh: 虞允文乞留銓，乃以爲寶文閣待制兼侍講。

translations.literal: Yu Yunwen requested that Hu Quan be retained; thereupon he was made academician of Baowen Pavilion and court lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen persuaded the court to keep Hu Quan, who was retained as Baowen Pavilion academician and lecturer.

sentences.zh: 己亥，皇太子謝于紫宸殿，宰相率百官赴東宮賀。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the Crown Prince gave thanks in the Hall of Purple Brightness; the chancellor led the hundred officials to the Eastern Palace to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, the crown prince acknowledged the investiture in the Purple Brightness Hall, while the chancellor and officials congratulated him at the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，以曾覿爲安德軍承宣使。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day wushen, Zeng Di was made commissioner-in-chief of the Ande Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wushen day, Zeng Di was appointed Ande Army commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔諸路增收無額錢物，並輸南上庫。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, an edict ordered all circuits to increase collection of extra-quota monies and goods, all remitted to the Southern Receipt Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, an edict required every circuit to levy surcharges beyond quota and send the proceeds to the Southern Receipt Treasury.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，從太上皇、太上皇后幸聚景園。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the emperor accompanied the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress to Jujing Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the emperor accompanied the retired emperor and empress to Jujing Garden.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔皇太子判臨安府。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, an edict ordered the Crown Prince to administer Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, an edict put the crown prince in charge of Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔侍從、臺諫、兩省官舉任刑獄、錢谷及有智略吏能者各二人。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, an edict ordered attendant officials, censorial remonstrators, and officials of the two Secretariat sections each to recommend two men competent in criminal adjudication, fiscal administration, and those with wisdom and strategic ability or administrative talent.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, an edict told court attendants, censors, and Secretariat officials each to nominate two men skilled in law, finance, or shrewd administration.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔皇太子領臨安尹。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, an edict ordered the Crown Prince to hold the post of prefect of Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, an edict made the crown prince prefect of Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，復置淮東總領所。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day wuyin, the Huaidong General Commandery was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuyin day, the Huaidong General Commandery was reinstated.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，劉珙起復同知樞密院事，爲荊、襄宣撫使，珙辭不拜。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Liu Gong was recalled from mourning as vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and made pacification commissioner of Jing and Xiang; Gong declined to accept appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Liu Gong was recalled as military vice commissioner and named Jing-Xiang pacification commissioner, but he refused the commission.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，金人葬欽宗于鞏原。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the Jin people buried Emperor Qinzong at Gongyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, the Jin buried Emperor Qinzong at Gongyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔廣西帥臣措置南丹州市馬。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, an edict ordered the military governors of Guangxi to arrange purchase of horses at Nandan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, an edict told Guangxi commanders to organize horse markets at Nandan.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣知閣門事王抃點閱荊、襄軍馬。

translations.literal: This month, Wang Bian, commissioner of the Palace Gate Office, was dispatched to inspect the troops and horses of Jing and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Wang Bian was sent to review Jing and Xiang forces and remounts.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，復主管馬軍司公事李顯忠爲太尉。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingwu, Li Xianzhong, supervisor of the Horse Guards Command, was restored to Defender-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the bingwu day, Li Xianzhong was reinstated as Grand Marshal after supervising the horse guards.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賜吳璘諡曰武順。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Wu Lin was granted the posthumous title Wushun.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, Wu Lin was posthumously titled Wushun.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔兩淮墾田毋創增稅賦。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, an edict ordered that reclaimed land in the two Huai circuits not be taxed with newly imposed levies.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, an edict forbade new taxes on newly opened land in the two Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，以王炎爲樞密使、四川宣撫使。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day gengzi, Wang Yan was made commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Sichuan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengzi day, Wang Yan was appointed military affairs commissioner and Sichuan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，詔兩淮民丁充民兵者，本名丁錢勿輸。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingchen, an edict ordered that among civilian households in the two Huai circuits serving as militiamen, head-tax money not be submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingchen day, an edict exempted Huai militiamen from paying the standard head tax.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，復修襄陽城。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Xiangyang city was repaired again.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, repairs resumed on the walls of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申朔，以江西、湖南旱，命募民爲兵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day of the month renshen, because Jiangxi and Hunan suffered drought, the people were ordered recruited as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth month's renshen new moon, drought in Jiangxi and Hunan prompted a call to enlist civilians as troops.

sentences.zh: 甲申，從太上皇、太上皇后幸東園。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the emperor accompanied the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress to Eastern Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the emperor escorted the retired emperor and empress to Eastern Garden.

sentences.zh: 戊子，安定郡王令德薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Prince of Anding Lingde died.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, Prince Lingde of Anding died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，罷紹興宗正行司，改恩平郡王璩判西外宗正。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day dingwei, the Shaoxing Imperial Clan Affairs Office was abolished; Prince of Enping Zhao Qi was changed to administer the External Imperial Clan Affairs for the West.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingwei day, the Shaoxing clan office was abolished and Prince Enping Qi was put in charge of western external clan affairs.

sentences.zh: 己酉，遣莫濛等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Mo Meng and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Mo Meng and others were sent to the Jin for the New Year embassy.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，金遣烏林答天錫等來賀會慶節，天錫要帝降榻問金主起居，虞允文請帝還內，命知閣門事王抃諭天錫以明日見，天錫沮退。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the Jin sent Wanyan Qian and others to congratulate the Huizqing Festival; Qian demanded that the emperor step down from the throne to inquire after the Jin ruler's health. Yu Yunwen asked the emperor to return to the inner palace; he ordered Wang Bian, commissioner of the Palace Gate Office, to inform Qian that he would receive audience the next day; Qian withdrew in dejection.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, the Jin envoy Wanyan Qian arrived for the Huizqing festival and insisted the emperor leave the throne to ask after the Jin ruler. Yu Yunwen had the emperor withdraw; Wang Bian told Qian he would be received the next day, and the envoy withdrew in humiliation.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，會慶節，金使隨班入見。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the Huizqing Festival; the Jin envoy entered audience following the court ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai Huizqing day, the Jin envoy was received in regular court order.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，御集英殿策試應賢良方正能直言極諫科李垕。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jiaxu, the emperor ascended the Hall of Assembled Eminences to conduct the examination by writ for the category Exemplary and Upright, Capable of Blunt Remonstrance; Li Kao was examined.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiaxu day, the emperor examined Li Kao in the Hall of Assembled Eminences for the "exemplary and upright remonstrator" degree.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，錫垕制科出身。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Kao was granted civil-service entry by the decree examination track.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Li Kao passed the special decree examination.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，遣翟紱等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dingwei, Zhai Fu and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingwei day, Zhai Fu and others were sent to the Jin for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔閣門舍人依文臣館閣以次輪對。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, an edict ordered Palace Gate Office secretaries to rotate presenting at court according to the order of civil officials in academy halls.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, an edict set gate secretaries to address the throne in rotation, following the sequence of academy civil officials.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，罷太醫局。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the Imperial Medical Bureau was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the Imperial Medical Bureau was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，金遣完顏宗甯等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the Jin sent Wanyan Zongning and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the Jin sent Wanyan Zongning and others for the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，湖南、江東西路旱，振之。

translations.literal: This year, Hunan and the Jiangdong and Jiangxi circuits suffered drought; relief was distributed.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought struck Hunan and Jiangdong and Jiangxi, and relief grain was issued.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月庚午朔，班《乾道敕令格式》。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the eighth year, on the new moon of the day gengwu, the Qiandao Edicts, Statutes, and Regulations were promulgated at court.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth year's first-month gengwu new moon, the Qiandao legal compendium was issued at court.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，朝獻景靈宮，遂幸天竺寺、玉津園。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the emperor presented offerings at Jingling Shrine, then visited Tianzhu Temple and Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the emperor worshipped at Jingling Shrine, then visited Tianzhu Temple and Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，詔改尚書左右僕射、同中書門下平章事爲左、右丞相。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yisi, an edict ordered that the Left and Right Grand Counselors, Chancellors of the Secretariat-Chancellery, be changed to Left and Right Grand Chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yisi day, an edict renamed the Left and Right Grand Counselors-chancellors as Left and Right Grand Chancellors.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔六察分隸，事有違戾，許監察御史隨事具實狀糾劾以聞。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, an edict ordered the six supervising censors divided in subordination; when matters were in violation, supervising censors were permitted to investigate each matter and submit substantive memorials of impeachment for report.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, an edict reorganized the six supervising censors and allowed impeachment memorials on any breach they found.

sentences.zh: 戊申，遣姚憲等使金賀上尊號，附請受書之事。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Yao Xian and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the honorific title, also requesting matters concerning receipt of the imperial letter.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Yao Xian and others were sent to the Jin to congratulate the new honorific title and also to press for receipt of the imperial letter.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以虞允文爲左丞相，梁克家爲右丞相，並兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Yu Yunwen was made Left Grand Chancellor and Liang Kejia Right Grand Chancellor; both also held the post of commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Yu Yunwen became left chancellor and Liang Kejia right chancellor, each also holding the military affairs commission.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以安慶軍節度使張說、吏部侍郎王之奇並簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Zhang Shuo, military commissioner of the Anqing Army, and Wang Zhiqi, Vice Minister of Personnel, were both appointed to sign documents at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Zhang Shuo and Wang Zhiqi were both appointed deputy military affairs commissioners.

sentences.zh: 侍御史李衡、右正言王希呂交章論說不可爲執政，不報。

translations.literal: Supervising censor Li Heng and Right Remonstrator Wang Xilü submitted memorials in succession arguing that Shuo must not serve in the chief council; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: Censors Li Heng and Wang Xilü jointly protested Zhang Shuo's return to power, but the court did not respond.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎兼直學士院周必大不草答詔，權給事中莫濟封還錄黃，詔並與在外宮觀。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites and drafter of the Hanlin Academy Zhou Bida refused to draft the reply edict; acting Chief Assessor Mo Ji sealed and returned the yellow draft; an edict ordered both given sinecures at external abbeys.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bida refused to draft the response, and Acting Assessor Mo Ji returned the sealed draft; both were sent to distant abbey sinecures.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔罷王希呂與遠小監當，尋詔與宮觀。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict dismissed Wang Xilü and assigned him to a distant minor supervisory post; soon an edict gave him an abbey sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Wang Xilü was banished to a remote minor post, then quickly given an abbey appointment instead.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，李衡罷爲起居郎。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Li Heng was dismissed and made imperial diarist.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Li Heng was removed and made imperial recorder.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，戶部尚書曾懷賜出身，參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Minister of Revenue Zeng Huai was granted civil-service entry and made Participation Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, Zeng Huai entered the chief council as participation secretary after receiving formal civil rank.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，詔省侍中、中書、尚書令員，以左、右丞充其位。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuzi, an edict ordered the posts of Palace Attendant, Secretariat Director, and Director of the Department of State Affairs abolished; the Left and Right Vice Directors were to fill those positions.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the wuzi day, an edict eliminated the titular heads of the three departments and had the left and right vice directors fill them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，賜禮部進士黃定以下三百八十有九人及第、出身。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day gengzi, three hundred eighty-nine Ministry of Rites jinshi from Huang Ding downward were granted pass and entry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengzi day, three hundred eighty-nine civil graduates from Huang Ding down passed the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 己酉，殿中侍御史蕭之敏劾虞允文擅權不公，允文請罷政，許之。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Palace censor Xiao Zhimin impeached Yu Yunwen for monopolizing power unjustly; Yunwen requested dismissal from government; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Xiao Zhimin accused Yu Yunwen of arbitrary power; Yunwen asked to leave office and was allowed.

sentences.zh: 翼日復留，出之敏提點江東刑獄。

translations.literal: The next day he was retained again; Zhimin was sent out as judicial intendant of Jiangdong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Yunwen stayed in power anyway, and Xiao Zhimin was posted out as Jiangdong judicial intendant.

sentences.zh: 甲子，措置兩淮官田徐子寅等坐授田歸正人逃亡，奪官有差。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, in arranging state land in the two Huai circuits, Xu Ziyin and others were punished for allotting land to returned-loyalist subjects who fled; offices were stripped with varying severity.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Xu Ziyin and others were demoted for assigning Huai state land to returned northerners who then fled.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔再蠲兩淮二稅一年。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, an edict ordered another remission of the two taxes in the two Huai circuits for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, an edict remitted both land taxes in the two Huai regions for another year.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，福建鹽行鈔法。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day wuzi, the salt ticket system was implemented in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuzi day, Fujian adopted the salt certificate system.

sentences.zh: 丙申，立宗室銓試法。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the imperial clan examination system was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, regulations were set for imperial clan civil examinations.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，以武德郎令撎爲金州觀察使，封安定郡王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengzi, Martial Virtue Gentleman Ling Yi was made observation commissioner of Jinzhou and enfeoffed as Prince of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengzi day, Ling Yi was made Jinzhou commissioner and created Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，蠲兩淮歸正人撮收課子。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, collected plot taxes on returned-loyalist subjects in the two Huai circuits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, levies on allotted plots held by returned northerners in the two Huai regions were remitted.

sentences.zh: 淮東巡尉有縱逸歸正戶口過淮者，奪官有差。

translations.literal: Huaidong patrol guards who had allowed returned-loyalist household registers to cross the Huai were punished; offices were stripped with varying severity.
translations.idiomatic: Huaidong patrol officers who let returned northerners slip back across the Huai were demoted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 壬子，省監司薦舉員。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, recommended personnel quotas for circuit and commission supervisors were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, nomination quotas for circuit supervisors were cut.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，罷淮西屯田官兵，募歸正人耕佃。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinsi, Huai West military colony officers and soldiers were abolished; returned-loyalist subjects were recruited to farm and tenant the land.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinsi day, Huai West military farms were shut and returned northerners were recruited to till them.

sentences.zh: 姚憲、曾覿至自金，金人拒其請。

translations.literal: Yao Xian and Zeng Di returned from the Jin; the Jin people rejected their request.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xian and Zeng Di returned from the Jin embassy with their petition denied.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以覿爲武泰軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day guimei, Di was made military commissioner of the Wutai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimei day, Zeng Di was appointed Wutai Army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, hail fell with rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，定江西四監鐵錢額。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day wuchen, iron coin quotas were fixed for the four mints of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the wuchen day, iron coin minting quotas were set for Jiangxi's four mints.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔王炎赴都堂治事。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an edict ordered Wang Yan to attend the Hall of State to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, an edict summoned Wang Yan to the chief council to take up duties.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以虞允文爲少保、武安軍節度使、四川宣撫使，封雍國公。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Yu Yunwen was made Junior Mentor, military commissioner of the Wu'an Army, and Sichuan pacification commissioner, and enfeoffed as Duke of Yongguo.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Yu Yunwen was made Junior Mentor, Wu'an commissioner, and Sichuan pacification commissioner, with the title Duke of Yongguo.

sentences.zh: 己丑，賜允文家廟祭器。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Yunwen was granted sacrificial vessels for his family temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Yu Yunwen was granted ritual vessels for his ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，允文入辭，帝諭以決策親征，令允文治兵俟報。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Yunwen entered to take leave; the emperor instructed him on the decision for a personal campaign, ordering Yunwen to ready troops and await word.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Yu Yunwen took leave; the emperor told him he might campaign in person and ordered him to ready troops pending word.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，遣馮撙等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day dingwei, Feng Zun and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingwei day, Feng Zun and others were sent to the Jin for the New Year.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，金遣夾穀清臣等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the Jin sent Jiagu Qingchen and others to congratulate the Huizqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, the Jin sent Jiagu Qingchen and others for the Huizqing festival.

sentences.zh: 罷借諸路職田。

translations.literal: The borrowing of official farmland on all circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The system of borrowing official farmland on the circuits was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，遣官鬻江、浙、福建、二廣、湖南八路官田。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day xinwei, officials were dispatched to sell state land in the eight regions of Jiang, Zhe, Fujian, the two Guang, and Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinwei day, officials were sent to sell state land in Jiang, Zhe, Fujian, the two Guang regions, and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，復四川諸州教授員。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, professor posts in the various prefectures of Sichuan were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, prefectural professors were restored across Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，進檢校少傅、知福州史浩開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Acting Junior Grand Tutor and prefect of Fuzhou Shi Hao was advanced to Grand Preceptor with honor equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day, Acting Junior Tutor and Fuzhou prefect Shi Hao was promoted to Grand Preceptor equal in honor to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，蠲兩淮明年租賦。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wuxu, rent and levies in the two Huai circuits for the coming year were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the wuxu day, next year's rents and taxes in the two Huai regions were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔京西招集歸正人授田如兩淮。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, an edict ordered Jing West to gather returned-loyalist subjects and grant land as in the two Huai circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, an edict told Jing West to settle returned northerners on land grants like those in the two Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，命四川試武舉。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Sichuan was ordered to hold the military examination.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Sichuan was ordered to hold the military examinations.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，追封劉光世爲安成郡王。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Liu Guangshi was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Liu Guangshi was posthumously created Prince of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣韓元吉等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Han Yuangji and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Han Yuangji and others were sent to the Jin for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 庚申，復置鑄錢司提點官二員。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, two supervisory officials for the Coinage Office were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, two coinage-office supervisors were reinstated.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，金遣曹望之等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the Jin sent Cao Wangzhi and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the Jin sent Cao Wangzhi and others for the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，隆興府、江、筠州、臨江、興國軍大旱，四川水。

translations.literal: That year, Longxing Prefecture, Jiang, Jun, Linjiang, and Xingguo Army suffered severe drought; Sichuan had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought struck Longxing, Jiang, Jun, Linjiang, and Xingguo while Sichuan flooded.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月辛未，王之奇罷爲淮南安撫使，王炎罷爲觀文殿大學士、提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the day xinwei of the ninth year, Wang Zhiqi was dismissed and made pacification commissioner of Huainan; Wang Yan was dismissed and made academician of the Guanwen Hall and administrator of Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the ninth year, on the first month's xinwei day, Wang Zhiqi was removed as chief minister and sent to Huainan as pacification commissioner; Wang Yan was dismissed to Guanwen Hall academician and Dongxiao Palace administrator.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以張說同知樞密院事，戶部侍郎沈夏簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Zhang Yue was made vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Vice Minister of Revenue Shen Xia was made deputy signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Zhang Yue was made vice director of Military Affairs and Revenue Vice Minister Shen Xia deputy signatory of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，遣官鬻兩浙營田及沒官田，次及江東、西、四川如之。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, officials were dispatched to sell garrison farmland and confiscated state land in the two Zhe regions; next Jiangdong, Jiangxi, and Sichuan were handled likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, officials were sent to sell garrison and confiscated land in Zhejiang and Zhedong, then Jiangdong, Jiangxi, and Sichuan in turn.

sentences.zh: 以刑部尚書鄭聞簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Zheng Wen was made deputy signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Justice Minister Zheng Wen was appointed deputy signatory of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，福建鹽復官賣法。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Fujian salt reverted to the government monopoly sales system.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Fujian salt returned to state monopoly retail.

sentences.zh: 是月，以措置兩淮、荊襄十六事敕安撫、轉運司督諸州守臣，月具所行事奏，仍審擇臧否，以議黜陟。

translations.literal: That month, by edict on the sixteen measures for arranging the two Huai and Jing-Xiang regions, pacification and transport commissions were ordered to supervise prefectural governors; each month they were to report actions taken, and still examine merit and fault for promotion and removal deliberations.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict on sixteen measures for the two Huai and Jing-Xiang circuits ordered pacification and transport officials to oversee prefects, submit monthly progress reports, and weigh performance for promotions and dismissals.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊申，以久雨，命大理、三衙、臨安府及兩浙州縣決系囚，減雜犯死罪以下一等，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day wushen, because of prolonged rain, the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Yamen, Lin'an Prefecture, and the two Zhe prefectures and counties were ordered to decide detained prisoners, reduce mixed offenses below capital crimes by one grade, and release those below the cane.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the wushen day, prolonged rain prompted orders for the judicial offices, Three Yamen, Lin'an, and the two Zhe circuits to clear jails—cutting non-capital mixed sentences one grade and releasing those below the cane threshold.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，修廬州城。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Luzhou's walls were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day, Luzhou's city walls were repaired.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大風。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, high winds struck.

sentences.zh: 幸天竺寺、玉津園。

translations.literal: The emperor visited Tianzhu Temple and Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor visited Tianzhu Temple and Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，蠲江西旱傷五州逋負米。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renshen, overdue grain owed by five drought-stricken prefectures of Jiangxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renshen day, grain arrears were remitted for five drought-hit Jiangxi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，青羌奴兒結寇安靜砦，黎州推官黎商老戰死。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the Qing Qiang Nu'erjie raided Anjing Stockade; Li Shanglao, judicial aide of Lizhou, died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Qing Qiang chieftain Nu'erjie attacked Anjing Stockade; Lizhou judicial aide Li Shanglao was killed in action.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，孫榮國公挺薨，追封豫國公。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Duke of Rongguo Sun Ting died; he was posthumously created Duke of Yuguo.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Duke of Rongguo Sun Ting died and was posthumously created Duke of Yuguo.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，特贈蘇軾爲太師。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Su Shi was specially posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Su Shi was posthumously granted the title Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，禁北界博易銀絹。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiawu, trade in silver and silk with the northern border was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiawu day, silver-and-silk trade with the Jin border was banned.

sentences.zh: 戊申，從太上皇、太上皇后幸聚景園。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the emperor accompanied the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress to Jujing Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, the emperor accompanied the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress to Jujing Garden.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，復以進奏院隸門下後省。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Memorial Reception Court was again placed under the Secretariat Rear Section.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the Memorial Reception Court was again subordinated to the Secretariat Rear Section.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，復分淮南安撫司爲東、西路。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the Huainan Pacification Commission was again divided into eastern and western circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Huainan pacification was re-split into eastern and western circuits.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，裁定武鋒軍軍額。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day dingchou, establishment quotas for the Wufeng Army were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingchou day, Wufeng Army quotas were set.

sentences.zh: 己丑，皇太子解臨安尹事。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the Crown Prince was relieved of his duties as prefect of Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, the Crown Prince stepped down as Lin'an prefect.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day renchen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon renchen day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己未，以迪功郎朱熹屢詔不起，特改宣教郎、主管台州崇道觀。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, because Disciplinary Officer Zhu Xi had repeatedly declined summons, he was specially changed to Gentleman for Propagating Education and made administrator of Taizhou's Chongdao Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, Zhu Xi—who had repeatedly declined imperial summons as a Diligent Officer—was promoted to Gentleman for Propagating Education and appointed administrator of Taizhou's Chongdao Abbey.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，禁兩淮、荊襄、四川諸州籍民戶馬。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiaxu, registration of civilian household horses in the two Huai, Jing-Xiang, and Sichuan prefectures was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiaxu day, civilian horse registration was banned in the two Huai, Jing-Xiang, and Sichuan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 己丑，戒飭監司、守令勸農。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, circuit intendants and prefectural magistrates were admonished to encourage farming.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, circuit and prefectural officials were ordered to promote agriculture.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，青羌奴兒結降。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day renyin, the Qing Qiang Nu'erjie surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renyin day, Qing Qiang chieftain Nu'erjie submitted.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，吐蕃彌羌畜列陷安靜砦，引兵深入，黎州守臣誘邛部川蠻擊卻之。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the Tibetan Micang chieftain Xulie captured Anjing Stockade and led troops deep inland; the Lizhou governor induced the Qiongbu River barbarians to strike and repulse them.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, Tibetan Micang leader Xulie took Anjing Stockade and pushed inland; Lizhou's governor rallied Qiongbu River tribes to drive him back.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，詔興修水利。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingzi, an edict ordered waterworks construction.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingzi day, an edict ordered irrigation works built.

sentences.zh: 癸未，合荊、鄂二軍爲一，以吳挺充都統制。

translations.literal: On the day guimei, the Jing and E armies were merged into one, with Wu Ting appointed supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimei day, the Jing and E armies were combined under Wu Ting as supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，梁克家等上《中興會要》、太上皇及皇帝玉牒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day bingshen, Liang Kejia and others presented the Essentials of the Restoration and the jade registers of the Retired Emperor and the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingshen day, Liang Kejia and others submitted 《Essentials of the Restoration》 and the jade genealogies of the Retired Emperor and the emperor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命盱眙軍以受書禮移牒泗州，示金生辰使，金使不從。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Xuyi Army was ordered to use the document-reception rite and send a dispatch to Sizhou informing the Jin birthday envoy; the Jin envoys refused.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Xuyi Army was told to follow document-reception protocol and notify Sizhou for the Jin birthday embassy; the Jin envoys refused.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，遣留正等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiazi, Liu Zheng and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiazi day, Liu Zheng and others were sent to the Jin for the New Year.

sentences.zh: 右丞相梁克家與同知樞密院張說議使事不合，乃求去。

translations.literal: Right Chief Minister Liang Kejia and Vice Director of Military Affairs Zhang Yue disagreed on embassy business, whereupon he requested to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Right Chief Minister Liang Kejia and Military Affairs Vice Director Zhang Yue clashed over embassy policy, and Liang asked to step down.

sentences.zh: 辛未，克家罷爲觀文殿大學士、知建寧府。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Kejia was dismissed and made academician of the Guanwen Hall and prefect of Jianning.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Liang Kejia was removed to Guanwen Hall academician and Jianning prefect.

sentences.zh: 壬申，矞雲見。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, auspicious clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, auspicious clouds were seen.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以曾懷爲右丞相，張說知樞密院事，鄭聞參知政事，沈夏同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Zeng Huai was made Right Chief Minister; Zhang Yue director of Military Affairs; Zheng Wen Vice Grand Councilor; Shen Xia vice director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Zeng Huai was made right chief minister, Zhang Yue director of Military Affairs, Zheng Wen vice grand councilor, and Shen Xia Military Affairs vice director.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，金遣完顏襄等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the Jin sent Wanyan Xiang and others to congratulate the Huizqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the Jin sent Wanyan Xiang and others for the Huizqing festival.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，襄等入辭，別函申議受書之禮，仍示虞允文速爲邊備。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Xiang and others entered to take leave, separately submitting in writing deliberations on the document-reception rite, also showing Yu Yunwen to hasten border preparations.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Wanyan Xiang and his party took leave, submitting separate memorials on document-reception protocol while urging Yu Yunwen to hurry border defenses.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，詔樞密院除授及財賦，事關中書、門下省，其邊機軍政更不錄送。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day xinmao, an edict stated that appointments and finances at the Bureau of Military Affairs touching the Secretariat and Chancellery should be forwarded, but border military matters need no longer be copied over.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinmao day, an edict required Military Affairs appointments and finances affecting the Secretariat and Chancellery to be forwarded—but frontier military matters were exempt from copy-forwarding.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，合祀天地於圜丘，大赦，改明年爲淳熙元年。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed at the Round Mound; a general amnesty was granted; the coming year was changed to the first year of Chunxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, joint Heaven-and-Earth rites were performed at the Round Mound, a general amnesty declared, and the next year renamed Chunxi 1.

sentences.zh: 十二月未朔，戒敕沿邊諸軍，毋輒遣間探、招納叛亡。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the new moon wei day, frontier armies were admonished by edict not to dispatch spies at will or recruit defectors and fugitives.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth month's new moon wei day, frontier armies were ordered not to send scouts casually or recruit defectors and deserters.

sentences.zh: 甲子，沈夏罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Shen Xia was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Shen Xia was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以御史中丞姚憲簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Censor-in-Chief Yao Xian was made deputy signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, Censor-in-Chief Yao Xian was appointed deputy signatory of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 遣韓彥直等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Han Yanzhi and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yanzhi and others were sent to the Jin for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 辛未，交阯入貢。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Jiaozhi presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Jiaozhi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，罷廣西客鈔鹽，復官般官賣法。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Guangxi merchant salt tickets were abolished and the government transport and government sales system restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Guangxi merchant salt notes were abolished and state transport-and-sale monopoly restored.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣使措置宜州市馬。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, envoys were dispatched to arrange horse markets at Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, envoys were sent to organize Yizhou horse markets.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以嗣濮王士輵、永陽郡王居廣並爲少保。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Succession Prince of Pu Shi Yi and Prince of Yongyang Ju Guang were both made Junior Mentors.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Pu heir Shi Yi and Prince of Yongyang Ju Guang were both made Junior Mentors.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，金遣完顏璋等來賀明年正旦，以議受書禮不合，詔俟改日。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the Jin sent Wanyan Zhang and others to congratulate the coming New Year; because deliberations on the document-reception rite did not agree, an edict ordered waiting for a changed date.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, the Jin sent Wanyan Zhang and others for the next New Year, but disputes over document-reception protocol led to postponement by edict.

sentences.zh: 以太上皇有旨，姑聽仍舊。

translations.literal: Because the Retired Emperor had given instructions, for the time being they were allowed to follow the old practice.
translations.idiomatic: On the Retired Emperor's orders, the old protocol was temporarily allowed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，璋等入見。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Zhang and others entered audience.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, Wanyan Zhang and his party were received in audience.

sentences.zh: 是歲，浙東、江東西、湖北旱。

translations.literal: That year, Eastern Zhe, Jiangdong and Jiangxi, and Hubei suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought hit Eastern Zhe, Jiangdong and Jiangxi, and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年春正月乙未，禁淮西諸關採伐林木。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chunxi, spring, first month, on the day yiwei, logging was prohibited at the passes of Huaixi.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Chunxi 1, on the first month's yiwei day, tree-felling was banned at Huaixi passes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，罷坐倉糴米賞。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, rewards for purchasing grain at seated granaries were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, bonuses for grain purchases at seated granaries were abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷兩淮將帥權攝官。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, acting appointments for generals in the two Huai circuits were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, interim command appointments in the two Huai regions were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙午，禁兩淮耕牛出境。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, draft oxen of the two Huai circuits were prohibited from leaving the border.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, draft oxen were barred from leaving the two Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 以交阯入貢，詔賜國名安南，封南平王李天祚爲安南國王。

translations.literal: Because Jiaozhi presented tribute, an edict granted the state name Annan and enfeoffed Prince of Nanping Li Tianzuo as King of Annan.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhi's tribute prompted an edict naming the realm Annan and creating Prince of Nanping Li Tianzuo King of Annan.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，虞允文薨。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day guiyou, Yu Yunwen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the guiyou day, Yu Yunwen died.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，爲郭浩立廟于金州。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, a temple for Guo Hao was erected at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, a temple was built for Guo Hao at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子朔，詔寄祿官及選人並去左右字。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day wuzi, an edict ordered salary officials and examination candidates alike to drop the zuo and you characters.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon wuzi day, an edict ordered stipendiary officials and examination candidates to drop the "Left" and "Right" qualifiers from titles.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以鄭聞爲資政殿大學士、四川宣撫使。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Zheng Wen was made academician of the Zizheng Hall and Sichuan pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, Zheng Wen was made Zizheng Hall academician and Sichuan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊申，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the emperor visited Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, the emperor visited Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，金遣梁肅等來計事。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Jin sent Liang Su and others to consult on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, the Jin sent Liang Su and others for consultations.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰，從太上皇幸聚景園。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day wuchen, the emperor accompanied the Retired Emperor to Jujing Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuchen day, the emperor accompanied the Retired Emperor to Jujing Garden.

sentences.zh: 壬申，許桂陽軍溪洞子弟入州學聽讀。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the sons of stream-cave communities in Guiyang Army were permitted to enter the prefectural school for audit study.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, youths from Guiyang's stream-cave settlements were allowed to audit the prefectural school.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔四川宣撫司教閱諸州將兵。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, an edict ordered the Sichuan Pacification Commission to drill the generals' troops of the prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, an edict ordered Sichuan pacification officials to drill prefectural generals' troops.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，遣張子顏等使金報聘。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Zhang Ziyan and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin on a return visit.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Zhang Ziyan and others were sent to the Jin on a return embassy.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以姚憲參知政事，戶部尚書葉衡簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Yao Xian was made Vice Grand Councilor; Revenue Minister Ye Heng was made deputy signatory of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Yao Xian was made vice grand councilor and Revenue Minister Ye Heng deputy signatory of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，班鄭興裔所創《檢驗格目》。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renyin, the Inspection Regulations compiled by Zheng Xingyi were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the renyin day, Zheng Xingyi's 《Inspection Regulations》 were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰朔，詔禮官討論別建四祖廟，正太祖東向位。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day bingchen, an edict ordered ritual officials to deliberate on separately building a Four Ancestors Temple and correcting Taizu's east-facing position.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon bingchen day, ritual officials were ordered to debate a separate Four Ancestors Temple and restore Taizu's east-facing seat.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以興州都統制吳挺爲定江軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Wu Ting, supreme commander at Xingzhou, was made military commissioner of the Dingjiang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, Xingzhou supreme commander Wu Ting was appointed Dingjiang Army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，改江陵府爲荊南府。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Jiangling Prefecture was changed to Jingnan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day, Jiangling Prefecture was renamed Jingnan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，曾懷罷。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Zeng Huai was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Zeng Huai was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，姚憲罷。

translations.literal: On the day guimei, Yao Xian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimei day, Yao Xian was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，落憲端明殿學士，罷宮觀。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Xian was stripped of his academician title at the Duanming Hall and dismissed from his abbey post.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Yao Xian was stripped of Duanming Hall academician rank and removed from his abbey appointment.

sentences.zh: 以葉衡參知政事。

translations.literal: Ye Heng was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Heng was appointed vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，以鄭聞參知政事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day dinghai, Zheng Wen was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dinghai day, Zheng Wen was made vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 罷四川宣撫司。

translations.literal: The Sichuan Pacification Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan Pacification Commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 以成都府路安撫使薛良朋爲四川安撫制置使。

translations.literal: Xue Liangpeng, pacification commissioner of Chengdu Prefecture Circuit, was made Sichuan pacification and military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu circuit pacification commissioner Xue Liangpeng was appointed Sichuan pacification and military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔舉廉吏。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, an edict ordered the recommendation of incorrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, an edict called for nominations of honest officials.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以曾懷爲右丞相。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Zeng Huai was made Right Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, Zeng Huai was made right chief minister.

sentences.zh: 己酉，姚憲南康軍居住。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Yao Xian was ordered to reside at Nankang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Yao Xian was relegated to residence at Nankang Army.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，張說罷爲太尉，提舉隆興府玉隆觀。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiwei, Zhang Yue was dismissed and made Grand Marshal, administrator of Yulong Abbey in Longxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiwei day, Zhang Yue was removed to Grand Marshal and administrator of Longxing's Yulong Abbey.

sentences.zh: 以徽猷閣學士楊倓爲昭慶軍節度使、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Yang Tan, academician of the Huayou Pavilion, was made military commissioner of the Zhaoqing Army and deputy signatory of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Huayou Pavilion academician Yang Tan was appointed Zhaoqing Army commissioner and deputy signatory of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉朔，以曾覿開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day yiyou, Zeng Di was made Grand Preceptor with honor equal to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon yiyou day, Zeng Di was promoted to Grand Preceptor equal in honor to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the emperor visited Yujin Garden for a banquet and archery.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day, the emperor banqueted and shot arrows at Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，罷宜州市馬。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Yizhou horse markets were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, Yizhou horse markets were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day jiashen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the new moon jiashen day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以禮部侍郎龔茂良參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Vice Minister of Rites Gong Maoliang was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, Rites Vice Minister Gong Maoliang was appointed vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 楊倓罷，以葉衡兼權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Yang Tan was dismissed; Ye Heng was concurrently appointed acting director of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Tan was removed and Ye Heng made acting director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，曾懷罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Zeng Huai was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day, Zeng Huai was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以葉衡爲右丞相兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Ye Heng was made Right Chief Minister and concurrently Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Ye Heng was made right chief minister and concurrent Military Affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，以吏部尚書李彥穎簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dingsi, Personnel Minister Li Yanying was made deputy signatory of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingsi day, Personnel Minister Li Yanying was appointed deputy signatory of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，遣吳琚等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Wu Ju and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Wu Ju and others were sent to the Jin for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，罷鐵錢，改鑄銅錢。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, iron coin was abolished and copper coin was cast instead.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, iron currency was abolished and copper coin minting resumed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔禮官論復魏悼王襲封。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, an edict ordered ritual officials to debate restoring the hereditary fief of Prince Daowei.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, ritual officials were ordered to debate restoring Prince Daowei's hereditary enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 壬申，葉衡等上《真宗玉牒》。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Ye Heng and others presented the Jade Register of Zhenzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Ye Heng and others submitted the 《Jade Register of Zhenzong》.

sentences.zh: 金遣劉仲誨等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: The Jin sent Liu Zhonghui and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin sent Liu Zhonghui and others for the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 以資政殿學士、知江陵府沈夏升大學士，爲四川宣撫使，仍命升差從主帥，場務還軍中。

translations.literal: Academician of the Zizheng Hall and Jiangling prefect Shen Xia was advanced to Grand Academician and made Sichuan pacification commissioner; he was still ordered to advance or reduce entourage per the commander, and market posts to return to the army.
translations.idiomatic: Zizheng Hall academician and Jingnan prefect Shen Xia was promoted to Grand Academician and Sichuan pacification commissioner, with orders to adjust his retinue per the commander and return market duties to the armies.

sentences.zh: 新四川制置使范成大改管內制置使。

translations.literal: Fan Chengda, the new Sichuan military commissioner, was changed to commissioner within his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: New Sichuan commissioner Fan Chengda was redesignated jurisdiction-wide commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸巳，前宰相梁克家、曾懷坐擅改堂除，克家落觀文殿學士，懷降爲觀文殿學士。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on the day guisi, former chief ministers Liang Kejia and Zeng Huai were punished for arbitrarily changing Hall appointments; Kejia was stripped of Guanwen Hall academician, and Huai was demoted to Guanwen Hall academician.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year, on the first month's guisi day, former chief ministers Liang Kejia and Zeng Huai were punished for unauthorized Hall appointments; Liang was stripped of Guanwen Hall academician rank and Zeng demoted to it.

sentences.zh: 甲午，廢同安、蘄春監。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the Tong'an and Qichun Superintendencies were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the Tong'an and Qichun superintendencies were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以兩淮諸莊歸正人安業，徐子寅等行賞有差。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, because returned-loyalist settlers on the various estates of the two Huai circuits had settled their occupations, Xu Ziyin and others received rewards in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, returned northerners who had settled on two Huai estates were rewarded; Xu Ziyin and others received differing awards.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔籍諸軍子弟爲背嵬軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, an edict ordered registering sons and brothers of the various armies as Back-line Elite troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, an edict ordered sons of army families enrolled in the Back-line Elite corps.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，以太上皇壽七十，詔禮官討論慶壽典禮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingshen, because the Retired Emperor reached seventy years, ritual officials were ordered to deliberate on birthday celebration ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingshen day, the Retired Emperor's seventieth birthday prompted orders for ritual officials to draft longevity-celebration rites.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔武舉第一人補秉義郎，堂除諸軍計議官。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an edict ordered the top military examination graduate to be appointed Bearer of Righteousness and Hall-appointed planning officer for the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, an edict made the top military examination graduate a Bearer of Righteousness and Hall-appointed army planning officer.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，賜禮部進士詹騤以下四百二十有六人及第、出身。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day yimao, Jin Wen and 426 others below him in the Ministry of Rites jinshi list were granted examination success and qualification.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yimao day, 427 Ministry of Rites jinshi—including Jin Wen—received degrees and qualifications.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the emperor visited Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the emperor visited Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 是月，茶寇賴文政起湖北，轉入湖南、江西，官軍數爲所敗，命江州都統皇甫倜招之。

translations.literal: That month, the tea-bandit Lai Wenzheng rose in Hubei, turned into Hunan and Jiangxi, and government troops were repeatedly defeated by him; Jiangzhou supreme commander Huangfu Ti was ordered to recruit him.
translations.idiomatic: That month tea-bandit Lai Wenzheng rebelled in Hubei and moved into Hunan and Jiangxi, repeatedly defeating government forces; Jiangzhou commander Huangfu Ti was ordered to win him over.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，諭宰相以朝政闕失，士民皆得獻言。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day xinmao, the chief ministers were instructed that on gaps and faults in court governance, scholars and commoners alike might all submit remarks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinmao day, chief ministers were told that scholars and commoners alike might speak on court failings.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命鄂州都統李川調兵捕茶寇。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Ezhou supreme commander Li Chuan was ordered to mobilize troops to capture the tea-bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Ezhou commander Li Chuan was ordered to mobilize troops against the tea rebels.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔知縣三年爲任。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an edict set three years as the term for county magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, an edict fixed county magistrates' terms at three years.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌朔，詔自今宰執、侍從以下除外任，非有功績者不除職名，外任人非有勞效，亦不除職。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day gengxu, an edict ordered that from now on chief ministers and attendants below, when posted outside the capital, would not have their titles cleared unless they had merit; those posted outside without effective labor likewise would not have titles cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon gengxu day, an edict barred clearing titles for chief ministers and attendants posted outside the capital unless they had merit, and likewise for outsiders without achievement.

sentences.zh: 以沈夏同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Shen Xia was made vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Xia was appointed vice director of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，罷四川宣撫司。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the Sichuan Pacification Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day, the Sichuan Pacification Commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 以倉部郎中辛棄疾爲江西提刑，節制諸軍，討捕茶寇。

translations.literal: Revenue Bureau Director Xin Qiji was made Jiangxi judicial intendant, controlling the various armies to hunt and capture the tea-bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue Bureau Director Xin Qiji was appointed Jiangxi judicial intendant to command troops against the tea rebels.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，用左司諫湯邦彥言，落蔣芾、王炎觀文殿大學士，張說落節度使，芾建昌軍、炎袁州、說撫州，並居住。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, following Left Secretariat Remonstrance Official Tang Bangyan's proposal, Jiang Fu and Wang Yan were stripped of Guanwen Hall Grand Academician rank, Zhang Yue was stripped of military commissioner rank; Fu to Jianchang Army, Yan to Yuanzhou, Yue to Fuzhou—all to reside there.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, on Left Secretariat remonstrator Tang Bangyan's advice, Jiang Fu and Wang Yan lost Guanwen Hall Grand Academician rank and Zhang Yue lost his commissioner title; Fu was relegated to Jianchang Army, Yan to Yuanzhou, and Yue to Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，振濟湖南、江西被寇州縣。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, relief was given to Hunan and Jiangxi prefectures and counties raided by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day, relief was sent to bandit-hit Hunan and Jiangxi prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 是月，茶寇自湖南犯廣東。

translations.literal: That month, the tea-bandits from Hunan invaded Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: That month the tea rebels pushed from Hunan into Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，有星孛於西方。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinchou, a broom star appeared in the west.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinchou day, a comet appeared in the west.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，江西總管賈和仲以捕茶寇失律，除名、賀州編管。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingchen, Jiangxi supreme commander Jia Hezhong, for irregularity in capturing tea-bandits, was stricken from the rolls and placed under guard at Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingchen day, Jiangxi commander Jia Hezhong was dismissed and placed under guard at Hezhou for misconduct against the tea rebels.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賜安南國王印。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the seal of the King of Annan was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the King of Annan's seal was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，蠲湖南、江西被寇州縣租稅。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, rent and taxes in Hunan and Jiangxi prefectures and counties raided by bandits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, rents and taxes were remitted for bandit-hit Hunan and Jiangxi prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，遣左司諫湯邦彥等使金申議。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Left Secretariat Remonstrance Official Tang Bangyan and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to state grievances.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Left Secretariat remonstrator Tang Bangyan and others were sent to the Jin to lodge complaints.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯朔，湯邦彥請分揚、廬州、荊南、襄陽府、金州、興元府、興州爲七路，每路文臣一人充安撫使以治民，武臣一人充都總管以治兵，三載視其成以議誅賞。
