translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day yimao, Tang Bangyan requested dividing Yang, Luzhou, Jingnan, Xiangyang Prefecture, Jinzhou, Xingyuan Prefecture, and Xingzhou into seven circuits; each circuit would have one civil official as pacification commissioner to govern the people and one military official as supreme commander to govern troops; after three years their results would be viewed to deliberate rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon yimao day, Tang Bangyan proposed splitting Yang, Luzhou, Jingnan, Xiangyang, Jinzhou, Xingyuan, and Xingzhou into seven circuits—each with a civil pacification commissioner for civilians and a military supreme commander for troops, with review after three years for rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，振恤淮南水旱州縣。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, relief was given to Huainan prefectures and counties suffering flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, relief was sent to flood- and drought-stricken Huainan prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 乙未，葉衡罷。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Ye Heng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day, Ye Heng was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，沈夏罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Shen Xia was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day, Shen Xia was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 贈趙鼎爲太傅，還其爵邑，追封豐國公。

translations.literal: Zhao Ding was posthumously made Grand Tutor, his title and fief restored, and posthumously created Duke of Fengguo.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ding was posthumously made Grand Tutor, his enfeoffment restored, and created Duke of Fengguo.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁巳，以李彥穎參知政事，翰林學士王淮簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day dingsi, Li Yanying was made Vice Grand Councilor; Hanlin Academician Wang Huai was made deputy signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the dingsi day, Li Yanying was made vice grand councilor and Hanlin academician Wang Huai deputy signatory of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔武臣從軍毋帶內職。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, an edict ordered military officers on campaign not to hold palace posts concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, an edict barred military officers on campaign from holding concurrent palace appointments.

sentences.zh: 是月，辛棄疾誘賴文政殺之，茶寇平。

translations.literal: That month, Xin Qiji lured Lai Wenzheng and killed him; the tea-bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xin Qiji lured and killed Lai Wenzheng, ending the tea rebellion.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅朔，賞平茶寇功，湖南、江西、廣東監帥黜陟有差。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day wuyin, rewards were granted for pacifying the tea-bandits; supervisory commanders of Hunan, Jiangxi, and Guangdong were promoted or removed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the new moon wuyin day, rewards were given for suppressing the tea rebels, and Hunan, Jiangxi, and Guangdong commanders were promoted or demoted accordingly.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，大風。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, high winds struck.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詣德壽宮，加上光堯壽聖憲天體道太上皇帝尊號曰「光堯壽聖憲天體道性仁誠德經武緯文太上皇帝」，壽聖明慈太上皇后尊號曰「壽聖齊明廣慈太上皇后」。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the emperor went to Deshou Palace and added to the honorific title of the Retired Emperor, previously "Guangyao Shousheng Xiantian Titdao Supreme Retired Emperor," the expanded title "Guangyao Shousheng Xiantian Titdao Xingren Chengdé Jingwu Weiwen Supreme Retired Emperor," and to the Retired Empress's honorific, previously "Shousheng Mingci Supreme Retired Empress," the expanded title "Shousheng Qiming Guangci Supreme Retired Empress."
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, the emperor visited Deshou Palace and extended the Retired Emperor's honorific to "Guangyao Shousheng Xiantian Titdao Xingren Chengdé Jingwu Weiwen Supreme Retired Emperor" and the Retired Empress's to "Shousheng Qiming Guangci Supreme Retired Empress."

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遣謝廓然等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Xie Kuoran and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Xie Kuoran and others were sent to the Jin for the New Year.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，金遣完顏禧等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the Jin sent Wanyan Xi and others to congratulate the Huizqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the Jin sent Wanyan Xi and others for the Huizqing festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申朔，奉上太上皇、太上皇后冊寶于德壽宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day wushen, the regalia for the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress were presented at Deshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the new moon wushen day, regalia was presented to the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress at Deshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，麗正門內火。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, fire broke out inside Lizheng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, fire broke out inside Lizheng Gate.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大風。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, high winds struck.

sentences.zh: 戊午，提點坑冶王揖進羨餘十萬緡，詔卻之。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Mining Supervisor Wang Yi presented a surplus of 100,000 strings; an edict refused it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, mining supervisor Wang Yi offered 100,000 strings in surplus revenue, but the court refused it by edict.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，班《淳熙吏部七司法》。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day xinsi, the 《Seven Laws of the Ministry of Personnel in Chunxi》 was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinsi day, the Seven Laws of the Ministry of Personnel in Chunxi was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 遣張宗元等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: Zhang Zongyuan and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyuan and others were sent to the Jin for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 甲午，朝德壽宮，行慶壽禮。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, court was held at Deshou Palace and longevity celebration rites were performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the emperor attended Deshou Palace and performed the longevity celebration rites.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 文武官封父母，賞諸軍。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials enfeoffed their parents; the various armies were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials ennobled their parents, and the armies were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 議放天下苗稅三之一，大臣言國用不足，乃止。

translations.literal: It was proposed to remit one-third of seedling taxes empire-wide; the chief ministers said state revenues were insufficient, whereupon it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: A proposal to remit one-third of seedling taxes nationwide was halted when ministers said revenues could not bear it.

sentences.zh: 丙申，更定強盜贓法。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the law on stolen goods in robbery cases was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day, robbery loot laws were revised.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，金遣完顏迨等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Jin sent Wanyan Dai and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day, the Jin sent Wanyan Dai and others for the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲寅，以常州旱，寬其逋負之半。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on the day jiayin, because Changzhou suffered drought, half its overdue payments were relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year, on the first month's jiayin day, half of Changzhou's arrears were remitted because of drought.

sentences.zh: 刪犯贓蔭補法。

translations.literal: The law on hereditary appointment for offenses involving embezzlement was deleted.
translations.idiomatic: The hereditary appointment law for embezzlement offenses was abolished.

sentences.zh: 振淮東饑，仍命貸貧民種。

translations.literal: Famine relief was given in Huaidong; the poor were also ordered lent seed grain.
translations.idiomatic: Huaidong famine was relieved and poor farmers were lent seed grain.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，振恤歸正人。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, returned-loyalist subjects were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day, returned northerners received relief.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，蠲兩淮教閱民兵夏稅。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renwu, summer taxes for drilled militia in the two Huai circuits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renwu day, summer taxes were remitted for drilled militia in the two Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以伯圭爲安德軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day guimei, Bogui was made military commissioner of the Andé Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimei day, Bogui was appointed Andé Army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔四川監司、帥守，聞命之官毋候告敕。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, an edict ordered Sichuan circuit supervisors and commanders, on receiving orders to take office, not to wait for patent edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, Sichuan circuit and command officials were ordered to take office without waiting for patent edicts.

sentences.zh: 賜韓世忠諡曰忠武。

translations.literal: Han Shizhong was granted the posthumous title Zhongwu.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shizhong was given the posthumous name Loyal and Martial.

sentences.zh: 是月，罷諸路鬻沒官田。

translations.literal: That month, the sale of confiscated state land on the various circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: That month the sale of confiscated state land on the circuits was halted.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午朔，日有食之，霧雲不見。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day bingwu, there was a solar eclipse; fog and clouds obscured it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon bingwu day, a solar eclipse occurred but was hidden by fog and clouds.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上《太上皇日曆》于德壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the 《Retired Emperor's Daily Record》 was presented at Deshou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day, the Retired Emperor's Daily Record was presented at Deshou Palace.

sentences.zh: 己未，置六部編敕司。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the Six Ministries Statute Compilation Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day, a Six Ministries statute-compilation office was established.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，幸報恩寺，遂幸聚景園。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the emperor visited Bao'en Temple, then visited Jujing Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, the emperor visited Bao'en Temple and then Jujing Garden.

sentences.zh: 己巳，並左藏四庫爲二。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the four vaults of the Left Treasury were merged into two.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, the Left Treasury's four vaults were consolidated into two.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔四川制置司歲擇梁、洋義士材武者二人，遣赴樞密院。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, an edict ordered the Sichuan Military Commission each year to select two able-bodied volunteers from Liang and Yang and send them to the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Sichuan commissioners were ordered each year to send two able volunteers from Liang and Yang to Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬申，立任子參選覆試法。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the re-examination law for sons of officials entering candidacy was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, a re-examination rule was established for official sons entering candidacy.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，詔侍從、臺諫、兩省官歲舉監司、郡守各五人。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day wuyin, an edict ordered attendants, censorate remonstrators, and officials of the two provinces each year to recommend five circuit intendants and prefects apiece.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuyin day, attendants, censorate remonstrators, and provincial officials were ordered each year to recommend five circuit intendants and prefects.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，靖州徭人寇邊，遣兵討捕之。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Yao people of Jingzhou raided the border; troops were dispatched to hunt and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Jingzhou Yao raided the frontier and troops were sent against them.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, hail fell with rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 己丑，責授葉衡德軍節度副使、郴州安置。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Ye Heng was demoted and appointed deputy military commissioner of the Dé Army and settled at Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day, Ye Heng was demoted to Dé Army deputy commissioner and relegated to Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，湯邦彥、陳雷奉使無狀，除名，邦彥新州、雷永州編管。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Tang Bangyan and Chen Lei performed their missions improperly and were stricken from the rolls; Bangyan placed under guard at Xinzhou, Lei at Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, Tang Bangyan and Chen Lei were dismissed for misconduct on embassy; Bangyan was placed under guard at Xinzhou and Lei at Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔諸路提刑歲五月理囚。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, an edict ordered judicial intendants on the various circuits each May to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, circuit judicial intendants were ordered to review prisons every May.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，合利州東、西路爲一。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guichou, Lizhou East and West Circuits were merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guichou day, Lizhou East and West Circuits were merged.

sentences.zh: 安南國王李天祚卒。

translations.literal: King Li Tianzuo of Annan died.
translations.idiomatic: King Li Tianzuo of Annan died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遣使弔祭。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, envoys were dispatched to mourn and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, envoys were sent to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Venus appeared in the daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day, Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，減四川酒課四十七萬餘緡。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yiyou, Sichuan liquor taxes were reduced by more than 470,000 strings.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yiyou day, Sichuan liquor taxes were cut by over 470,000 strings.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以朱熹屢詔不起，特命爲秘書郎，熹不就。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, because Zhu Xi had repeatedly declined summons, he was specially appointed Secretariat Gentleman; Xi did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, Zhu Xi—who had repeatedly declined summons—was specially appointed Secretariat Gentleman but refused the post.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，禁浙西圍田。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day yichou, polder fields in Western Zhe were prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yichou day, polder reclamation in Western Zhe was banned.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，以王淮同知樞密院事，禮部尚書趙雄簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yihai, Wang Huai was made vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Rites Minister Zhao Xiong was made deputy signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the yihai day, Wang Huai was made Military Affairs vice director and Rites Minister Zhao Xiong deputy signatory.

sentences.zh: 詔六察官糾察庶務，臺綱益振，各進二官。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Six Investigation officials to scrutinize miscellaneous affairs; censorate discipline was further strengthened, and each was advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: An edict empowered Six Investigation officials to audit affairs, bolstering censorate discipline; each was promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太上皇詔立貴妃謝氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the Retired Emperor issued an edict establishing Consort Xie as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, the Retired Emperor ordered Consort Xie created empress.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以久雨，命中外決系囚。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, because of prolonged rain, the court and provinces were ordered to decide detained prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day, prolonged rain prompted orders to clear jails at court and in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，靖州徭寇平。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the Jingzhou Yao bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the Jingzhou Yao rebellion was suppressed.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，詔自今犯公罪至死者，其蔭補具所犯奏裁，著爲令。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guihai, an edict ordered that from now on when offenses of official crimes reach death, the hereditary appointments of dependents must state the offenses submitted for judgment, established as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guihai day, an edict required hereditary appointments to report capital public offenses for review when dependents sought privilege.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，以久雨，命中外決系囚。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiaxu, because of prolonged rain, the court and provinces were ordered to decide detained prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiaxu day, prolonged rain again prompted jail reviews at court and in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 丙子，御文德殿，冊皇后。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the emperor attended Wendé Hall and enregistered the empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day, the emperor enregistered the empress at Wendé Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命臨安守臣嚴禁逾侈。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Lin'an governors were ordered strictly to prohibit extravagance.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, Lin'an officials were ordered to crack down on extravagance.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔自今非歉歲不許鬻爵。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, an edict ordered that from now on sale of ranks was not permitted except in years of crop failure.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day, an edict barred sale of ranks except in famine years.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣閻蒼舒等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day guimei, Yan Cangshu and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimei day, Yan Cangshu and others were sent to the Jin for the New Year.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，金遣蒲察通等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the Jin sent Pucha Tong and others to congratulate the Huizqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, the Jin sent Pucha Tong and others for the Huizqing festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，合祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day guichou, Heaven and Earth were jointly sacrificed at the Round Mound; a general amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guichou day, joint Heaven-and-Earth rites were performed at the Round Mound and a general amnesty declared.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣張子正等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Zhang Ziyan and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day, Zhang Ziyan and others were sent to the Jin for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，黎州蠻寇邊，官軍失利，蠻亦遁去。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jichou, Li barbarians raided Lizhou's border; government troops suffered defeat, and the barbarians also fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jichou day, Li tribes raided Lizhou; government troops lost but the tribes also withdrew.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔職事官補外者，復除職如故事。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, an edict ordered that functional officials filling outside posts should again have their titles cleared as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, an edict restored the old practice of clearing titles for officials posted outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 追封吳玠爲涪王。

translations.literal: Wu Jie was posthumously created Prince of Fu.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jie was posthumously created Prince of Fu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，定鑄錢司歲鑄額爲十五萬緡。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the Coinage Office's annual casting quota was fixed at 150,000 strings.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day, the Coinage Office annual quota was set at 150,000 strings.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，金遣劉珫等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the Jin sent Liu Wan and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, the Jin sent Liu Wan and others for the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京西湖北諸州、興元府、金、洋州旱，紹興府、台、婺州水，並振之。

translations.literal: That year, Jing West and Hubei prefectures, Xingyuan Prefecture, Jin and Yang Prefectures suffered drought; Shaoxing Prefecture, Tai and Wu Prefectures had flooding—all were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought struck Jing West, Hubei, Xingyuan, Jin, and Yang while Shaoxing, Tai, and Wu flooded—all received relief.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月戊申，詔自今內外諸軍歲一閱試。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the day wushen, an edict ordered that from now on all armies inside and outside the capital be inspected once each year.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on the first month's wushen day, an edict ordered annual inspection of all armies at court and in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔沿江諸軍歲再習水戰。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, an edict ordered armies along the Yangzi to drill in naval warfare twice each year.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day, an edict ordered Yangzi garrisons to drill naval warfare twice yearly.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, hail fell with rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，班《淳熙曆》。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the 《Chunxi Calendar》 was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day, the Chunxi Calendar was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，幸太學，祗謁先聖，退御敦化堂，命國子祭酒林光朝講《中庸》。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yihai, the emperor visited the Imperial Academy, reverently paid homage to the Sage, withdrew to Dunhua Hall, and ordered Guozi Chancellor Lin Guangchao to lecture on the 《Doctrine of the Mean》.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yihai day, the emperor visited the Imperial Academy, paid homage to Confucius, then withdrew to Dunhua Hall and had Guozi chancellor Lin Guangchao lecture on the Doctrine of the Mean.

sentences.zh: 下詔，遂幸武學，謁武成王廟。

translations.literal: An edict was issued; then the emperor visited the Military Academy and paid homage at the Temple of the Martial Completion King.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed, and the emperor visited the Military Academy and the Temple of the Martial Completion King.

sentences.zh: 監、學官進秩一等，諸生推恩、賜帛有差。

translations.literal: Supervisors and academy officials were advanced one rank; students received extended favor and silk grants in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisors and academy officials gained one rank, and students received honors and silk grants in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔諸軍毋以未補官人任軍職。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, an edict ordered the various armies not to assign military posts to persons not yet formally appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, an edict barred armies from posting unappointed men to military duties.

sentences.zh: 戊子，立邊人逃入溪洞及告捕法。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, laws were established on border people fleeing into stream caves and on reporting and capture.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day, laws were enacted on frontier deserters fleeing to stream-cave settlements and on reporting and capture.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，立武臣授環衛官法。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the law on granting Guard posts to military officers was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi day, rules were established for conferring Guard appointments on military officers.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以新知荊南府胡元質爲四川安撫制置使兼知成都府。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the newly appointed prefect of Jingnan Hu Yuanzhi was made Sichuan pacification and military commissioner while also knowing Chengdu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day, new Jingnan prefect Hu Yuanzhi was appointed Sichuan pacification and military commissioner and Chengdu prefect.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，以史浩爲少保、觀文殿大學士、醴泉觀使兼侍讀，進封永國公。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day yisi, Shi Hao was made Junior Mentor, Guanwen Hall Grand Academician, Liquan Abbey administrator and concurrent reader-in-waiting, and advanced to Duke of Yongguo.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the yisi day, Shi Hao was made Junior Mentor, Guanwen Grand Academician, Liquan Abbey administrator and reader-in-waiting, and created Duke of Yongguo.

sentences.zh: 己酉，龔茂良等上《仁宗玉牒》、《徽宗實錄》、《皇帝玉牒》。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Gong Maoliang and others presented the 《Jade Register of Renzong》, the 《Veritable Record of Huizong》, and the 《Jade Register of the Emperor》.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day, Gong Maoliang and others submitted the Jade Register of Renzong, Veritable Record of Huizong, and the Emperor's Jade Register.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the emperor visited Yujin Garden for a banquet and archery.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, the emperor banqueted and shot arrows at Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 壬子，貸隨、郢二州饑民米。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, grain was lent to famine sufferers in Sui and Ying Prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, grain was lent to famine sufferers in Sui and Ying.

sentences.zh: 詔李龍𣉙襲封安南國王。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Longqian to inherit the title King of Annan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict created Li Longqian King of Annan by succession.

sentences.zh: 甲寅、修韶州城。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Shaozhou's walls were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Shaozhou's walls were repaired.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幸聚景園。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the emperor visited Jujing Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day, the emperor visited Jujing Garden.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，以魏王愷爲荊南、集慶軍節度使、行江陵尹、判明州如故。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jiaxu, Prince of Wei Kai was made military commissioner of Jingnan and the Jiqing Army, acting Jiangling prefect, and judge of Mingzhou as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiaxu day, Prince of Wei Kai was made Jingnan and Jiqing commissioner, acting Jiangling prefect, while retaining his Mingzhou judgeship.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，參知政事龔茂良以曾覿從騎不避道，杖之。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Vice Grand Councilor Gong Maoliang, because Zeng Di's mounted escort did not yield the road, had him beaten with the staff.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, Vice Grand Councilor Gong Maoliang had Zeng Di beaten for failing to yield the road with his mounted escort.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上奏乞罷政，不許。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, he submitted a memorial requesting dismissal from office; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Gong Maoliang asked to resign but was refused.

sentences.zh: 甲午，給歸正官子孫田屋。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, fields and dwellings were granted to descendants of returned-official subjects.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, land and houses were granted to descendants of returned officials.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子朔，幸佑聖觀。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the first day gengzi, the emperor visited Yousheng Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon gengzi day, the emperor visited Yousheng Abbey.

sentences.zh: 罷四川和糴。

translations.literal: Sichuan compulsory grain purchase was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan compulsory grain purchases were abolished.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，龔茂良罷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingchou, Gong Maoliang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the dingchou day, Gong Maoliang was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以王淮參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Wang Huai was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, Wang Huai was appointed vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，班《幸學詔》。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the 《Imperial Academy Visit Edict》 was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, the Imperial Academy Visit Edict was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 癸未，升蜀州爲崇慶府。

translations.literal: On the day guimei, Shuzhou was promoted to Chongqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimei day, Shuzhou was elevated to Chongqing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔自今宰執朝殿得旨，事須覆奏乃行。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, an edict ordered that from now on when chief ministers received imperial instructions at court audience, matters must be resubmitted for confirmation before implementation.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day, an edict required chief ministers to resubmit court instructions for confirmation before acting.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，禁江上諸軍盜易戰馬。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day xinchou, Yangzi armies were prohibited from illicitly trading war horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinchou day, Yangzi garrisons were barred from illicit horse trading.

sentences.zh: 振襄陽饑民。

translations.literal: Famine relief was given to hungry people in Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangyang famine sufferers received relief.

sentences.zh: 壬寅。

translations.literal: On the day renyin.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day.

sentences.zh: 立待補太學試法。

translations.literal: The examination law for waiting-list Imperial Academy candidates was established.
translations.idiomatic: Examination rules were established for wait-listed Imperial Academy candidates.

sentences.zh: 戊申，班御史臺彈奏格。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the Censorate impeachment regulations were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day, Censorate impeachment regulations were promulgated.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，罷臨川伯王雱從祀。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, attendant sacrifice for Linchuan Earl Wang Pang was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Wang Pang was removed from attendant sacrifice rites.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，龔茂良責授寧遠軍節度副使、英州安置。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Gong Maoliang was demoted and appointed deputy military commissioner of the Ningyuan Army and settled at Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day, Gong Maoliang was demoted to Ningyuan deputy commissioner and relegated to Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，申嚴四川入蕃茶禁。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Sichuan's prohibition on tea entering Tibetan areas was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Sichuan's ban on tea entering Tibetan regions was strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 甲子，班《淳熙重修敕令格式》。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the 《Revised Statutes and Formats of Chunxi》 was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day, the Revised Statutes and Formats of Chunxi was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，禁耕牛過淮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinsi, draft oxen were prohibited from crossing the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the xinsi day, draft oxen were barred from crossing the Huai.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day dingyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon dingyou day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命修築海潮所壞塘岸。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, repair of dyke embankments damaged by tidal surges was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day, orders went out to repair sea-dyke embankments damaged by tidal surges.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，免宰執以下會慶節進奉。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, tribute offerings for the Huizqing Festival from chief ministers downward were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day, chief ministers and below were exempted from Huizqing festival tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命禮官定開寶、政和祀禮。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, ritual officials were ordered to fix the sacrificial rites of Kaibao and Zhenghe eras.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day, ritual officials were ordered to fix Kaibao- and Zhenghe-era sacrificial rites.

sentences.zh: 戊午，閱蹴踘於選德殿。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, cuju football was reviewed at Xuande Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day, cuju was reviewed at Xuande Hall.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，以久陰，命中外決系囚。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day bingzi, because of prolonged overcast, the court and provinces were ordered to decide detained prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingzi day, prolonged overcast prompted jail reviews at court and in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 遣錢良臣等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: Qian Liangchen and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Liangchen and others were sent to the Jin for the New Year.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔監司、守臣歲舉武臣堪知縣者各二人。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, an edict ordered circuit supervisors and prefectural governors each year to recommend two military officers fit to be county magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day, circuit and prefectural officials were ordered each year to recommend two military officers fit for county magistracies.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔將士智勇傑出者，躐等升差。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, an edict ordered that officers and soldiers outstanding in wisdom and courage might skip ranks for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day, an edict allowed exceptional officers and soldiers promoted out of rank order.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，金遣完顏忠等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Jin sent Wanyan Zhong and others to congratulate the Huizqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the Jin sent Wanyan Zhong and others for the Huizqing festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，詔兩淮歸正人爲強勇軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day dingyou, an edict ordered returned-loyalist subjects of the two Huai circuits enrolled in the Strong and Brave Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the dingyou day, an edict enrolled two Huai returned northerners in the Strong and Brave Army.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以趙雄同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Zhao Xiong was made vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Zhao Xiong was appointed Military Affairs vice director.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Venus appeared in the daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day, Venus was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遣趙思等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Zhao Si and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day, Zhao Si and others were sent to the Jin for the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，試四川所上義士二人，官而遣之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dingmao, two volunteers submitted from Sichuan were examined, given office, and dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingmao day, two Sichuan volunteers were examined, granted office, and dispatched.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔行薦舉事實格法。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, an edict ordered implementation of the factual verification regulations for recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, an edict ordered factual-verification rules for recommendations enforced.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，大閱。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, a grand review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day, a grand military review was held.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，蠲太平州民貸常平錢米。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, loans of Ever-Normal Granary cash and grain to people of Taiping Prefecture were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Ever-Normal Granary loans to Taiping residents were remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，金遣完顏炳等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the Jin sent Wanyan Bing and others to congratulate the coming New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day, the Jin sent Wanyan Bing and others for the next New Year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，福州、建甯府、南劍州水，並振之。

translations.literal: That year, Fuzhou, Jianning Prefecture, and Nanjian Prefecture had flooding—all were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year flooding struck Fuzhou, Jianning, and Nanjian—all received relief.
